tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che la ldan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyis dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i don 'grel khog phub mthong ba rab dga'i gsal byed bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs// bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed rgya mtsho mngon par bsrubs pa las byung sku gsum nyin mor byed pa'i dpal/ /spros pa'i chu 'dzin ma lus zhi ba'i chos dbyings mkha' la dpag yas smon lam myur 'gro bdun ldan zhing / /legs bshad dri bsung don gnyer blo gros dbang po mchog ldan nyan thos rang rgyal rgyal sras tshogs dang 'phrin las can/ /'od brgya'i dra bas blo gros pad+mo rgyas mdzad kun mkhyen nyin byed dbang po rgyal gyur cig /dpag yas yon tan du ma'i gter gyur gsung rab rgya mtsho'i dbus na cher gnas shing / /stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo gros lus zung dmigs med brtse ba'i gtsug gi nor bu'i rgyan gyis spras/ /snang ba'i chos kun gdod nas skyes med zab mo'i don gyi ro 'dzin gnyis stong ldan pa can/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtsho chen po'i khyab bdag rje btsun gong ma lnga yis bdag skyongs shig /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum rang bzhin can/ /rigs gsum mgon po rnam gsum phyis rab snyigs ma'i dus nyid du/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i don du sa skya'i rje btsun skur bzhengs te/ /bstan pa rin chen gsal mdzad sngags 'chang chos rje yab sras dang / /'khor lo'i mgon dang sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa srung mdzad rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ /dang 'dod yid ches ldan pas sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /phyi nang bar chad sel zhing dngos grub rnam gnyis legs stsal te/ /rnam bshad bsam don kun 'grub spel la rnam dpyod spobs pa stsol/

/de la 'dir bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs dam par sngon gyi dus su thugs bskyed dang smon lam rnam par dag pa'i rgyu mthun gyi las dkar yang dag pa'i mthu la brten/ snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs ma'i dus su gyur cing / dmu rgod gdul dka'i sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ni/ /khyim pa 'khor lo bsgyur rnams su/ /gyur nas skye ba thams cad du/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi ltar na zad mi shes pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi dpal la dbang 'byor ba'i sgo nas/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i snang brnyan lta bur gyur nas/ gdul bya rnams kyi re 'dod yongs su bskangs par mdzad la/ de ltar na'ang nang don shes bya'i gnas thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa tshad med pa mnga' ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bor gdon mi za bar bzhugs shing / snang tshul phan bde'i 'byung gnas rje btsun sa skya pa'i sde gdung brgyud/ bstan pa rin po che bstan 'dzin dgon gnas dang bcas pa thams cad mi nyams shing gong 'phel du mdzad pa por/ gos dkar lcang los mdzes par theg pa mchog gi dge bsnyen du skur bstan nas/ mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya 'khor du ma 'dus pa rnams bsdus/ bsdus pa rnams smin/ smin pa rnams grol/ grol ba rnams mthar phyin pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / khyad par du yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i lung gi bstan pa rin po che nyid 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ bshad nyan sgrub gsum/ thos bsam sgom gsum la sogs pa thabs tshul du ma'i sgo nas dar rgyas su bya ba'i gzhir 'gyur ba'i thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ rgyud 'grel 'grel bshad dang bcas pa/ sgrub dkyil rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ mdo mdo 'grel dang bcas pa/ rig gnas yan lag dang bcas pa sogs la/ rnam bshad rnam thar/

chog khrid phyag len/ bstod tshig gsol 'debs/ rtsod lan rtsod spong / nyams mgur zhal gdams la sogs pa mtha' yas pa mdzad pa rnams kyi nang nas/ 'dir ni sngon tshe sprul pa'i lo tsā dpal brtsegs drung / /phyis rab rgyal sras sa ston rir grags pa/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs skyong phyir slar byon pa'i/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i mtshan khyod bsngags par 'os/ /zhes pa dang / grags ldan kun tu bzang po'i rnam par sprul/ /rtsod pa'i dus su thams cad mkhyen par grags/ /'dzam gling bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nges pa'i don du drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid 'phags yul rdo rje'i gdan du snyan pa'i grags pas 'dzin ma'i khyon ma lus par khyab pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i skur bzhengs/ de nyid slar bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud kyi nang tshan du sku rnam par sprul zhing / lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod pa'i dus 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bur gyur/ de nyid 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi lung rtogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag lha rigs 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung rigs dri ma med pa chos rgyal 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes par sku skye ba bzhes nas mdzad pa rmad du byung ba du ma zhig mdzad la/ khyad par du yang bka' bstan bcos/ lung man ngag du ma'i dgongs 'grel rnam bshad sogs rtsom pa nor bu'i phreng ba du ma tshar du dngar bar mdzad pa las 'dir ni chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che de nyid la 'dan ma dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya bas dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba/ brjod bya mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po'i gnad mang po gsal bar ston cing rjod byed sh+lau ka lnga phrag gcig gis lhag pa'i bcu phrag brgyad kyi bdag nyid can 'di yin la/ 'di nyid la rgya bod hor gsum sogs su dgongs pa rnam par 'grel ba'i rnam bshad mang du byung ba gzhir bcas na'ang phyin ci ma log par 'grel bar byed pa ni gong du gnas tshul rags pa phul ba ltar dang /

khyad par rje nyid kyis/ /skye ba du mar sbyangs pa'i blo gros kyis/ /shes bya ma lus mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun dga'i mtshan can zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum/ spangs rtogs mdzad gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum la sogs pa'i yon tan mtha' yas shing gting dpag dka' bar mnga' ba'i skyes chen dam pa/ sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes 'dzam gling kun tu nyi zla ltar snyan pa dang grags pa'i ba dan ches cher g.yo bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid can 'di nyid kyis legs par bka' stsal ba chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che la 'dan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyis dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i don 'grel khog phub mthong ba rab dga' zhes bya ba 'di nyid gang gtan la 'bebs par bya ba'i gzhi yin la/ 'di nyid 'chad pa la/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa klad kyi don/ brtsam par bya ba dngos kyi don/ bya ba mthar phyin mjug gi don dang gsum las/ dang po la'ang skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod par brjod pas/ dkon mchog rnam gsum/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro/ nor lha nyan rang sogs mchod 'os kun la mchod par 'gyur bas na/ na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ zhes gsungs te/ rtsom pa po gang de'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la sgo gsum dang ba'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal/ zhes dang por rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod par brjod pa la/ na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye sogs byung / rtsa ba'i bla ma de'ang brgyud pa'i bla ma la brten nas 'byung zhing / brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi nang nas kyang / rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa la lugs gnyis char gyi sgo nas bka' drin ches cher stsol ba ni/ 'khrul pa'i dri mas ma gos 'od gsal lha'i rigs/

spang bya las 'khon de rgyal 'khon ston brgyud pa'i rigs/ gnas las mtshan gsol sa skya pa zhes 'jam dbyangs kyi rigs te brgyud pa gsum ldan rje btsun sa skya pa zhes snyan grags lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i rnga bo che'i sgra ltar rgya mtsho'i gos can tsam ma lags par/ sa gsum mam/ khams gsum mam srid pa gsum na che ba las kyang cher gsal bar mdzad pa po ni/ lung rtogs chos kyi rgyal po/ lugs gnyis phun tshogs dpal ldan/ byis pa'i spyod yul las 'phags/ theg chen 'phags pa'i sar bzhugs gang de'i zhabs pad dri ma med pa la snying nas 'dud do zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod par brjod pa'i rjes su brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mchog de nyid la mchod par brjod pa la/ dri med 'od gsal lha rigs 'khon gyi brgyud/ /sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i rnga bo che/ /srid pa gsum na ches cher gsal ba yis/ /bka' drin stsol mdzad dpal ldan 'phags par 'dud/ /ces pa 'di byung / de nyid brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mchog yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'di la chos srid gnyis char gyi bka' drin che ba'i sgo nas te/ de yang 'jam dbyangs khyod kyi zhabs sen gong ma se chen rgyal po'i spyi bor gus pas bsten/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus/ dam chos khyad par can de nyid kyi yon du bod yul shing sgo 'dzin pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol/ bod yul chol kha gsum la sogs pa phul ba nas bzung / da lta bar du rje btsun sa skya pa'i chos srid gang gi yang mnga' 'bangs su ma gyur pa su yang med pas so/ /de skad du yang / khyod kyi drin las dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab pa nas/ /bzung ste sa skya'i 'bangs su ma gyur pa'i/ /dbus gtsang khams 'dir skye bo su yod smros/ /zhes ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod las so/ /zhes mchod par brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan bka' drin che tshul dang bcas pa ston pa la/

khyod zhabs se chen rgyal pos legs bsten nas/ /shing sgo 'dzin pa'i bod yul chol kha gsum/ /dam chos yon du phul ba nas bzung ste/ /sa skya pa yi 'bangs su ma gyur su/ /zhes pa 'di byung / rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir na sa steng na gnas pa'i skye bo thams cad kyi mchod par 'os pa dang / bskur bar 'os pa dang / brten par 'os pa dang / skyabs su bya ba'i 'os dam par gyur pa ni dpal ldan sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i chos kyi spyan ldan rnams yin la/ chos kyi spyan ldan de rnams kyi gdung rigs dang / chos srid kyi rgyun legs par 'dzin pa la blang dor gyi gnas rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros can sngags 'chang kun dga'i mtshan ldan kho bo yang brgyud pa khungs ldan nas legs bshad 'di lta bu'i rnam bshad byed pa la spro ba mchog tu gyur pas rnam par bshad pa 'di nyid rtsom mo zhes rtsom par dam bca' ba'i tshul ston pa la/ de phyir sa steng gnas pa thams cad kyi/ /mchod par 'os pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /rigs dang chos kyi brgyud 'dzin blo gros can/ /sngags 'chang kho bo legs bshad 'chad la spro/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de ltar rtsom par dam bcas pas rtsom pa la bar chad mi 'byung zhing rtsom pa mthar phyin pa dang / gzhan yang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum la sogs pa chos ldan gyi bya ba'i sgo nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid mchog tu rgyas shing yar ngo'i zla ltar gong nas gong du 'phel nus pa'i nus pa khyad par can/ skyabs gnas bslu med sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma rnams dang / de dag gi bstan pa'i rgyun 'dzin bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong ba'i chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa khyed rnams da lta lta byed dbang po'i spyod yul du mi mngon yang / zab mo chos kyi dbyings kyi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ gzigs pa sgrib med du gzigs pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs/

thugs rje dang mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi dpung chen po skyed la sngags 'chang bdag la 'bad med lhun grub tu stsol cig ces skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la thugs rje chen pos bskul ba'i tshul ston pa la/ sa skya'i rje btsun bstan 'dzin bstan srung bcas/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i dpung bskyed la/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /mchog tu 'phel ba'i nus pa bdag la stsol/ /ces pa 'di byung / de rnams kyi sgo nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba dang / thugs rje bskul ba dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams sngon du btang ba ste bshad zin to/ /zhes ston pa la/ zhes mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba dang / thugs rje bskul ba dang bcas pa'i tshig sngon btang nas/ zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /gnyis pa brtsam par bya ba dngos kyi don ni/ 'dir sa 'og sa steng / sa bla ste sa gsum mam/ 'dod khams/ gzugs khams/ gzugs med khams te khams gsum gyi 'gro ba kun gyi bla ma/ mgon/ skyabs/ rten/ gling / gnas/ dpung gnyen chen po chos kyi rgyal po rin po che 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis hor gyi rgyal khams rnams phan bde la 'god pa'i ched du thengs gnyis phyag legs par phebs pa'i phyi ma dgung lo so gsum pa'i tshe/ sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bka' gdams pa dbang phyug 'bum zhes pa dgung lo drug cu re gcig bzhes pa de dang 'dam thog tu mjal/ dri ba dris lan sogs chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad pas/ chos kyi rgyal po de nyid la 'dan ma dbang phyug 'bum nyid bdud las kyis mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob cing / dbang dang sems bskyed sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi yang mang du gsol bar mdzad la/ 'on kyang dri ba sum cu ba'i dri tshig 'di rnams ni/ gong du chos kyi rgyal po nyid la gdan sa chen po rang du bzhugs tshe phul ba 'dra bar snang ste/

'dam thog tu bzhugs skabs der nub gcig dge slong des zhu cha la/ bdag gis ston pa dkon mchog seng ge la bskur ba'i zhu yig de rnams la lan legs pa gcig ma byung bar kho bo yid chad par yod pas/ bla mas sngar ma grub kyang mar la gdan drangs nas ma gir mdzad nas yar bskur ba'am/ yang na sa skya lta bur zhu yig 'di dang gsung 'phrin bsdebs nas bskur na lan yong ba'i rigs e yod ces zhus pa'i tshe/ sa skya na 'di lta bu'i lan 'ong ba yod na nga kho na dga' ste med/ khyod kyi yi ge rnams tshags byas yod gsungs nas chos khug nas zhu yig gi yi ge rnams phyung / mar me'i 'od la bla ma nyid kyis lan re re nas bklags te/ 'di la khyed ji ltar 'dod zer ba re re nas dris/ de rnams kyi lan 'di ltar 'ong ba yin gsungs nas mtshan yal der de rnams kyi lan gsungs/ zhus dag mdzad nas 'jam ser 'di rnams khyod kyis tshags gyis shig 'di rnams la lung rigs thams cad 'dzoms pa'i lan legs pa khong mnyes pa zhig ma gir byas nas slar yar la bskur ba yin gsungs nas zhu yig rnams khong la gtad song / zhes dge ba'i bshes gnyen de nyid kyi chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar tho yig gi tshul can de nyid las 'byung bas so/ /de ltar na dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu 'di ni/ 'di rang gi sbyar byang nas gsungs pa ltar mdo khams tshal mdor mdzad nas zhu ba por gnang ba yin lags/ des na 'dan gyi yul du 'khrungs pas na 'dan ma zhes grags la/ mtshan dngos ni dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya ba de nyid kyis dri ba snying nas zhus pa'i tshe/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis spyir bstan pa dang sems can/ bye brag zhu ba po la thugs dkyil gyi zhar nas gsungs pa'i dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i bsdus don gyi 'grel pa/ dri ba'i gzhung dang lan gyi gzhung thad sor sbyar nas bstan pas/

brjod don rags pa'i khog rnams phub nus pa/ rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i skyes bu skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis mthong ba tsam gyis rab tu dga' ba skyed par byed nges pas na mthong ba rab dga' zhes bya ba 'di nyid 'chad pa la/ gzhung 'di'i dbu zhabs kyi don thams cad hril gyis bsdu na gsum ste/ mgo bo'i dkyil gyi klad pa dang 'dra bas klad kyi don/ tshil gzhung ril po yan lag dang bcas par 'dra bas gzhung gi don/ mjug ma dang 'dra bas mjug rdzogs pa'i don dang gsum gyis 'chad cing / dang po klad kyi don la nang gses yan lag gi dbang du byas na/ dris lan nyid kyi mchod par brjod pa dang rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis kyis dbye ba la sogs pa bsdus don gyi sgo nas rtsa ba lus dang / gyes pa yan lag lta bu'i tshul gyi 'chad tshul ston pa la/ 'dir sa gsum gyi bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che la/ 'dan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyis dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i don 'grel khog phub mthong ba rab dga' zhes bya ba 'di nyid 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po klad kyi don la dris lan gyi mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis las/ dang po mchod par brjod pa de nyid ston par byed pa la/ zhes pa 'di byung / de nyid tshig don dngos kyi sgo nas dang po mtshan don mchod brjod rnam pa gnyis dang bcas pa de nyid ston par byed pa ni dris lan sogs te/ de yang spyir dri ba 'dri ba dang / lan 'debs pa'i tshul la/ mgo gcig pa dang rnam phye dang / /dri dang bzhag par lung bstan par/ /skye dang 'chi dang khyad par 'phags/ /bdag gzhan la sogs lta bu yin/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu/ mgo gcig pa'i dri ba/ skyes pa thams cad 'chi'am mi 'chi zhes 'dri na/ skyes ba thams cad 'chi zhes mgo gcig pa'i lan dang /

shi ba thams cad skye'am mi skye zhes 'dri na/ nyon mongs pa ma spangs par shi ba thams cad skye/ nyon mongs pa spangs te shi ba thams cad mi skye zhes rnam par phye ba'i lan dang / yang mir skyes pa khyad par 'phags sam mi 'phags zhes 'dri na/ gang la ltos te yin zhes dris te/ ngan song gsum la ltos te mir skyes pa khyad par 'phags/ lha la ltos te mir skyes pa dman/ zhes slar yang dris pa'i lan dang / bdag phung po las gzhan yin nam/ bdag phung po dang gcig yin zhes 'dri na/ khyad gzhi bdag med pas khyad chos phung po dang gcig dang gzhan gang du yang lung bstan du mi nus pas na bzhag pa'i lan la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang / des na mkhas pas thal 'gyur lan/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi gdab/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa mtha' yas pa yod kyang / 'dir ni gsung rab mang po'i nang nas/ zab don dka' gnas kyi dri ba sum cu zhus pa las/ lung rigs man ngag gsum gyi sgo nas nges shes rnam par 'dren nges kyi lan yin pas na rnam par nges pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes mtshan don ston pa la/ dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes pa 'di byung / de'i rjes su bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod par brjod pa de ston pa la/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i rjes su chu mgo gangs la thug pa'i tshul gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bdag nyid/ rgyud ltar na rdo rje 'chang / mdo ltar na thub pa'i dbang po de nyid la mchod par brjod pa ni/ gang gi mkhyen brtse sogs te/ de yang thabs tshul gang gi sgo nas bstod na/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas ste/ de yang shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / tha dad du bya ba brgyad kyis khyad par du byas pa'i brtse ba thugs rje chen po goms pa mthar phyin pas phul du byung zhing nus pa mthar phyin pa mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul gyi 'phrin las dpag tu med cing mtha' yas pas dus rtag par gdul bya gzhan gyi don 'ba' zhig mdzad pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i bla mar gyur pa'i ston pa sangs rgyas la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po la mchod par brjod pa la/ gang gi mkhyen brtse phul byung zhing / /mthu dang 'phrin las mtha' yas pas/ /rtag par gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i/ /'gro ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de ltar mchod par brjod nas las su bya ba ci bya na/ blo gros sam shes rab rab tu gsal zhing gus par bya ba'i yul mchog tu gyur pa dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo bla ma la shin tu gus pa/ 'dan ma'i yul du 'khrungs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya ba de nyid kyis/ chos la don gnyer gyi 'dun pa drag po dang ldan pa'i bsam pa dge bas kun nas bslangs te dris pa'i lan rnams/ dri ma med pa'i bka' mdo rgyud man ngag bstan bcos rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin skabs 'dir bshad par bya'o/ /zhes gnyis pa dri ba'i lan gyi rtsom par dam bca' ba de nyid ston par byed pa la/ blo gsal bla ma la gus pa'i/ /dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya ba yis/ /bsam pa dge bas dris pa'i lan/ /dri med lung bzhin 'dir bshad bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de yan chad kyis klad kyi don nam mgo bo'i don la mchod par brjod pa'i don dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba'i don gnyis yod pa'i 'bru gnyer ba de rnams song nas/ da ni gnyis pa gzhung gi don nam lus kyi don dngos la dri ba'i tshig khyad par du 'phags shing dogs pa'i gnad dang ldan nges pa'i dri ba sum cu zhus pa la/ de dag dang grangs go rim mthun pa'i dris lan yang ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba sum cu thams cad go rim ji lta ba bzhin du bshad par bya ba yin no/ /zhes dbu dang lus gnyis kyi bar gyi mtshams sbyor te ston pa la/ de yan chad kyi klad kyis don la dris lan gyi mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis yod pa de song nas/ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la dri ba khyad par du 'phags pa sum cu zhus pa las/

de dang mthun pa'i dris lan ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sum cu gnang ba rnams go rim bzhin du 'dir bshad par bya ba las/ zhes pa 'di byung / de la yang dri ba dang po dngos ni thub pa sogs te/ 'o skol gyi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po 'di nyid/ thar pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i dus thog ma'i sa mtshams theg dman bye brag smra ba'i lugs la/ 'dzam bu gling pa tshe lo brgya pa'i dus rgyal bu don 'grub kyi sku rten dgung lo sum cu so lnga pa la/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan du gsar du sangs rgyas par 'dod pa de bzhin du/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sngags kyi lugs la yang de dang mthun par bzhed lags sam/ de dang mi mthun pa'i dus gang la sangs rgyas ma thag pa'i dus su bzhed pa lags/ zhes zhus pa'i dri ba de ston par byed pa la/ de la dri ba dang po ni/ thub pa byang chub sangs rgyas pa'i/ /sa mtshams theg chen ga la bzhed/ /ces pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsungs pa ni/ shākya thub pa sogs te/ de yang khyed kyis ji ltar dri ba bzhin/ 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya thub pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas ma thag pa'i dus kyi 'dod tshul la/ grub mtha' dang theg pa'i bye brag gi bye brag tu smra ba'i bzhed tshul de ka ltar lags shing / theg pa chen po'i lugs la'ang yo ga la mkhas pa mi gsum gyi nang tshan slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen ni/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa yang bye brag tu smra ba dang mthun par mdzad de/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan du gsar du sangs rgyas par bzhed/ gzhan theg pa chen po'i slob dpon rnams gsung mthun par/ sangs rgyas ma thag pa'i dus bskal ba grangs med dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu yin par mdo rgyud sna tshogs nas gsungs pas dus 'di rang zhes pa'i nges pa mi mdzad cing / 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mi rnams tshe lo brgya ba'i dus rgyal rigs kyi rten la rdo rje'i gdan du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes pa lta bur mdzad pa ni/

mi'i snang ngor sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa'am mchog gi sprul sku'i sprul pa'i mdzad pa kho na ston pa yin te/ sprul gzhi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la brten nas sprul pa sna tshogs su ston pa sprul sku spyi'i mdzad pa'i khyad chos yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i snying por bzhugs pa ga la ba der gshegs te/ byang chub sems dpa' de la ched du rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i skur bstan nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /zhes sogs gsungs la/ de'i don rnams sgra ji bzhin par zhal gyis bzhes te/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i ko sa la'i rgyan las bshad pa ltar rnam smin gyi lus nai ra dza ṇa'i 'gram du bzhag nas/ yid kyi lus 'og min du gshegs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mngon byang lnga bstan pas sangs rgyas par bzhed pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i mngon par byang chub pa'i grangs nges phye ba las/ mdor na bye brag tu smra ba dang / yo ga ba shākya bshes gnyen ma gtogs longs spyod rdzogs sku 'dod pa thams cad/ ston pa 'og min du longs skur sangs rgyas zin nas/ spyir mdzad pa dpag tu med pa dang / bye brag mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir skal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong gis theg pa thun mong gi ngor mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang / rdo rje theg pas 'dul ba'i gdul bya'i ngor sngags kyi lam gyis sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa mthun no/ /zhes gsungs/ de skad du yang rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ 'og min stug po nyams dga' 'dir/ /stug po'i zhing khams 'jig med pa/ /de nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos/ /rdzogs par longs spyod tshul 'di 'byung /

/zhes pa dang / yang rgyud gzhan dag las kyang / gtsang ma'i gnas dag spangs pa yi/ /'og min zhes bya nyams dga' ba/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po gcig 'dir 'tshang rgya/ zhes pa dang / lang kar gshegs pa las/ 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du/ /sangs rgyas mngon par sangs mi rgya/ /gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du/ /'dod chags bral khyod 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes pa dang / yang mdo las/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'og min du/ /sangs rgyas ma gyur 'dod khams su/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mi mdzad do/ /zhes dang / gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las kyang / bcom ldan 'das bskal ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sngon rol tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas shākya'i rigs su sku'i skye ba ston par mdzad do/ /zhes pa dang / mgon po byams pas rgyud bla ma las/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /zhes pa la sogs gsungs pa dang / slob dpon rin po che rtse mo zhabs kyis kyang / de bas na yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i thog mar sangs rgyas nas/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'di phyis bskal ba bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa yin no/ /zhes bya ba 'di ni theg pa chen po'i slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang / zla ba grags pa dang / kun dga' snying po dang / skal ldan grags pa la sogs pa phal che ba'ang bzhed la/ kho bo cag gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyang bzhed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen gyi zhal snga nas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /stug po bkod par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid yin/ /de yi sprul pa'i sku nyid ni/ /zas gtsang sras su 'khrungs pa yi/ /shākya seng ge 'di yin no/ /zhes pa dang / mkhas grub kun dga'i mtshan can gyis kyang /

khyad par thub dbang shākya'i rgyal po yis/ /grangs med bskal ba'i sngon du stug po'i zhing / /'jig med gnas der byang chub mchog brnyes nas/ /slar yang 'dzam gling 'phags yul ser skya yi/ /grong khyer chen por mang bkur rgyal po'i rigs/ /zas gtsang sras su sa pho 'brug la bltams/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po nas mthun par gsungs so/ /zhes dri ba dang po'i lan de ston pa la/ shākya thub pa sangs rgyas pa'i/ /dus ni bskal ba grangs med sngon/ /'dir ni tshe lo brgya pa la/ /byang chub brnyes pa sprul pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba gnyis pa'i zhus tshig ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad sogs te/ /de yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas des chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs zhes pa'i phung po'i tshad de ji tsam la 'jog cing / grangs kyang brgyad khri bzhi stong der nges lags sam/ zhes dri ba zhus tshul ston pa la/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong phung po'i tshad ci lags/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de ltar zhus pa'i lan dngos ston par byed pa ni/ rjod byed sogs te/ de yang gtso che ba la rjod byed kyi tshig rab byed dam/ le'u dang / skabs dang / bam po sogs mang nyung ci rigs pa 'dus pa'i sgo nas brjod bya'i don gyi rnam grangs mang nyung ci rigs pa ston pa la/ de yang mdzad pa po'i ngag rgyun gcig gis bsdus pa'i gzhung lugs gcig la/ chos phung zhes gsungs pa'i phung po de nyid yin/ de nyid la rab byed dang le'u sogs 'dus pa nges par mi dgos te/ sher phyin yi ge gcig ma dang / tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa'i mdo sogs mang du yod pa'i phyir/ chos phung de'i tshad la/ kha cig bstan bcos tshad ces zer/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgya gar ba'i slob dpon kha cig mngon pa sde bdun gyi nang tshan chos kyi phung po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos shā ri'i bus mdzad pa 'di la sh+lau ka stong yod pas/

de tsam pa re la chos phung re re'i tshad yin zhes zer mod kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis/ phung po la sogs gtam re yin/ /zhes phung po lnga lta bu'am khams bco brgyad lta bu chos tshan re re'i mgo mjug gi gtam rdzogs par ston pa la chos phung re re'i tshad du 'jog pas/ sh+lau ka'i grangs mang nyung gcig tu nges pa yod pa ma yin no/ /chos phung de'i grangs la gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas/ chos kyi phung po phrag brgyad khri dag /ces pa dang / chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ zhes pa dang / nyon mongs 'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /mdo sde'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /'dul ba'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /nyon mongs gti mug 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /mngon pa'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /dug gsum cha mnyam 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /sngags kyi sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar spang bya so so ba 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum spong zhing / brjod bya so so ba ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum ston par byed pa'i/ rjod byed so so ba mdo sde'i sde snod/ 'dul ba'i sde snod/ mngon pa'i sde snod de sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum dang / spang bya dug gsum spyir spong zhing / bslab bya bslab pa gsum spyir ston pa gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde/ de ltar na mdo sde'i sde snod la khri tsho gnyis dang stong phrag gcig 'dul ba'i sde snod la khri tsho gnyis dang stong phrag gcig mngon pa'i sde snod la khri tsho gnyis dang stong phrag gcig sngags kyi rgyud sde la khri tsho gnyis dang stong phrag gcig ste kun sdom pas stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'am khri tsho brgyad dang stong phrag bzhi'am/

brgyad khri dang bzhi stong rnams ming gi rnam grangs tsam ma gtogs don mthun pas de tsam zhig yod do zhes gsungs par grags la/ grags zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas de ltar mtha' gcig tu nges pa zhal gyis bzhes mi nus par bstan te/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong zhes pa ni/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can theg pa chen po'i chos la mos pa dman pa rnams theg pa chen por kha drang ba'i phyir/ theg dman gyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ theg pa chen po'i dbang du byas na re re la'ang sa ya dang / dung phyur la sogs pa yod par bshad pas/ mtha' yas pa'am bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang thams cad mkhyen pa ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis tshul gsum gsal rgyan las/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong zhes bshad pa/ /nyan thos mos pa dman rnams drang phyir te/ /theg chen lugs la dbye ba bsam mi khyab/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan gsal bar ston par byed pa la/ rjod byed rab byed 'dus pa yis/ /brjod bya'i rnam grangs mang ston pa'i/ /ngag rgyun gcig ni bsdus pa'i gzhung / /phung po nyid yin de yi tshad/ /gcig tu nges pa yod ma yin/ /spang bya nyon mongs gsum spong zhing / /brjod bya bslab pa gsum ston pa'i/ /rjod byed sde snod rnam pa gsum/ /so so ba dang spyir ston pa/ /brgya khri bzhi stong yod ces grags/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba gsum pa'i zhu tshig ni/ sngags dang pha rol phyin pa'i zhes sogs te/ de yang theg pa chen po'i lam la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam dang / mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gnyis gsungs te/ de gnyis kyi lam dang 'bras bu la khyad par yod dam med/ yod na gang gi sgo nas byed pa lags/ zhes dri ba zhus tshul ston pa la/ sngags dang pha rol phyin pa'i lam/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i khyad par gang / /zhes pa 'di byung / de ltar zhus pa'i lan dngos ston par byed pa ni/

byang chub sems kyi gzhi zhes sogs te/ de yang theg pa de gnyis kyi 'bras bu mthar thug de'i ngo bo la khyad par med kyang / 'bras bu'i ming dang lam bgrod tshul la khyad par shin tu yang yod de/ theg chen pha rol phyin pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che nyid theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba yin pas/ de nyid thog mtha' bar gsum du lam gyi gzhi rten du byas/ de nas chos thams cad kyi stong nyid don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / thabs snying rje chen po zung du 'jug pa'i nyams len la brten nas tshogs sbyor gyi lam gnyis bgrod/ de nas stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / thabs snying rje chen po'i zung 'jug gi rtogs pa de nyid zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du gong 'phel du byas/ spang bya mthong spang dang sgom spang rnams rim gyis spangs/ rtogs bya mthong lam dang sgom lam gyi sa bcu rim gyis bgrod/ de dag gi gnas skabs su tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing / rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum la brten nas sa bcu pa'i rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi skad cig phyi logs de ma thag tu spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug sa grangs kyi sgo nas sa bcu gcig pa'i ming can de nyid 'grub par 'gyur ba ni/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lugs kyi sa lam bgrod tshul yin pas so/ /de skad du sdom gsum rab dbye las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /de yi 'di bzhin spyad par bya/ /yang na pha rol phyin pa yi/ /mdo las ji ltar 'byung bzhin gyis/ /zhes pa dang / 'on kyang theg pa chen po yi/ /sde snod rnams las gsungs pa bzhin/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ /grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsags/ /sems can yongs su smin pa dang / /sangs rgyas zhing rnams legs par sbyongs/ /sa bcu'i mtha' mar bdud btul nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gsungs/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ theg chen rdo rje theg pa pa ni/ thog mar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa las/ smin byed nor ba med pa'i dbang bzhi blangs/ de nyid lam gyi rtsa ba'am gzhir bzung nas/ grol byed 'khrul pa med pa'i lam rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa goms par byas te dpe'i ye shes mngon du byas/ der rjes spyod pa chung 'bring che gsum gyis lam gyi bogs dbyung nas sa bcu gnyis pa'i bar gyi sa lam rnams rim gyis bgrod/ mthar nye rgyus mtshams sbyar te spangs rtogs ma lus pa mthar thug pa bde chen gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ 'bras bu'i gtso bo bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa 'grub cing / de ltar sgrub pa ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag yin te/ de skad du yang sdom gsum rab dbye las/ pha rol phyin gzhung mi nus par/ /gal te gsang sngags bsgom 'dod na/ /nor sa med pa'i dbang bzhi longs/ /'khrul pa med pa'i rim gnyis bsgom/ /de las byung ba'i ye shes ni/ /phyag rgya chen por goms par bya/ /de nas 'khor 'das bsre ba'i phyir/ /rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa spyod/ /nang gi sa lam kun bgrod nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dge ba/ /bcu gsum pa ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /ces pa'i zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ byang chub sems kyi gzhi bsten nas/ /stong nyid snying rje'i lam gyis ni/ /spangs rtogs phun tshogs bcu gcig pa/ /bsgrub pa pha rol phyin pa'i lugs/ /smin byed dbang gi gzhi bzung nas/ /rim gnyis yan lag bcas pa yis/ /spangs rtogs bde chen bcu gsum pa/ /sgrub pa sngags kyi rnam gzhag yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba bzhi pa'i zhu tshig ni/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas sogs te de yang sgron bskal gyi bskal pa bzang po zhes grags pa'i bskal chen 'di la byon cing 'byon par 'gyur ba'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa mos pa'i bar gyi sangs rgyas stong phrag gcig po de rnams kyi dam pa'i chos gsungs tshul la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang / /zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar na/ bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong po thams cad kyis gsang sngags kyi theg pa gsungs pa ltar snang zhing / yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa 'di ni/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas 'od srung gi bar gyis kyang ma gsungs/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa nas mos pa'i bar gyis kyang mi gsungs/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'di kho na'i bstan pa la byung ba yin/ zhes pa'i dgongs don ltar na thub pa'i dbang po nyid ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyis ma gsungs pa ltar snang la/ de ltar na gsungs pa don la 'thad lags sam/ ma gsungs don la 'thad lags/ zhes pa'i dri ba zhus tshul ston pa la/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /sngags kyi theg pa gsung lags sam/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de ltar zhus pa'i lan gsal bar ston par byed pa ni/ skal bzang sangs rgyas sogs te/ de'i don yang 'grel chen 'bum nag las/ gsang sngags gdul bya'i snod las 'byung / /zhes 'byung pa ltar/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad dang / khyad par bskal ba bzang po 'di'i sangs rgyas stong phrag gcig po thams cad kyi gdul bya gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos ston pa'i snod rung du gyur cing / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su len nus pa'i skal ldan gyi gang zag mchog de yang skal ldan rigs bzhi zhes pa rgyud sde rin po che rnam bzhi'i lam dang 'bras bu 'grub pa'i rigs can/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor rnams la/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsang sngags gsungs pas na/ mtshan brjod las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa 'di nyid la dgongs pa yin/ gzhan sangs rgyas kyis stong pa'i yul du skyes pa'i mi la sogs pa snod du ma gyur pa'i gang zag la gsang sngags zab mo'i chos lta ci smos/ chos zhes pa'i sgra dang sangs rgyas zhes pa'i sgra tsam yang thos pa'i skal ba med par gsungs/ 'on kyang rang re'i ston pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid can 'di nyid kyis snyigs ma lnga bsdo zhing dmu rgod gdul dka' ba'i sems can rnams la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan pas kyang thugs bskyed rgya che ba dang / thugs nye bar brtse ba dang / smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mthu nus la brten nas/ gdul bya rigs can gsum gyi nang tshan theg pa chen po'i rigs can mdo sngags gnyis ka'i thun mong ba'i 'khor rnams la thugs rje'i rang bzhin/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid/ thugs rje'i ngo bo/ thugs rje'i gzugs can shākya thub pa/ shākya seng ge shākya'i rgyal po/ shākya'i gtso bo 'di kho nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i zab chos rnams gsungs pa yin pas/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po zhes de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan rnams dang bka' drin mnyam pa med pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chen por gsungs pa 'di kho na bka' drin che ba yin cing / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi gsang sngags kyi theg pa 'di ni zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'ang 'di nyid yin no/ /'di ni gzhung gi 'bru dang sbyar ba'i don tsam yin la/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa ga la yin te/ slob dpon rin po che'i spyi rnams chen mo las/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la sogs pas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsang sngags gsungs par bshad pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus gsung ba dang / ma gsungs par bshad pa ni/ sprul sku'i ma gsung ba bzhed/

slob dpon zla ba grags pa la sogs pa mang po ni/ gsung rab bshad pa nges don dang / ma gsung bar bshad pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i che ba brjod pa tsam yin gsungs/ slob dpon ar+ya de wa gsung bar bshad pa/ gsung gcig nyid du gsung mod kyi/ /zhes pa'i don dang / ma gsungs par bshad pa/ du ma nyid du so sor go /zhes pa'i don lta bu yin gsungs/ yang slob dpon kha cig gsungs par bshad pa spyir gsang sngags gzhan yin la/ ma gsungs par bshad pa gsang ba 'dus pa 'ba' zhig yin gsungs pa la sogs pa bzhed srol mang du bkod kyang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams rtse mo'i mtshan can nyid 'di bzhin bzhed pa'i mtha' gcod par mi mdzad pas na/ bdag lta bu'i so so skye bos lta smos kyang ci dgos lta bu yin pas so/ /zhes zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ skal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /gdul bya mchog la gsang sngags gsungs/ /mtshan brjod dgongs pa de nyid yin/ /thun mong ba yi 'khor rnams la/ /shākya thub pa kho nas gsungs/ /gsang 'dus dgongs pa'ang 'di yin no/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba lnga pa'i zhu tshig ni/ rgyud sde mi yi zhes sogs te/ de yang rang cag gi ston pa thugs rje chen po 'di gsang sngags theg pa rnams gsungs na/ rgyud sde de rnams mi'i yul 'dir dar ba'i tshul lam dar ba'i lugs mdor bsdu na ji ltar lags/ zhes pa'i dri ba zhus tshul ston pa la/ rgyud sde mi yi yul 'dir ni/ /dar lugs mdor na ji ltar lags/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de ltar zhus pa'i lan gsal bar ston par byed pa ni gdul bya'i skal ba'i sogs te/ de yang snga rabs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed srol bzhin bkod pa ni/ gdul bya rang rang so so'i khams dang / bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / dbang po'i rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du sngon gyi tshe bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i dus su thub pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa mchog gi dkyil 'khor mngon par sprul par mdzad nas/

skal ldan gyi lha dang grub pa chen po brgyad la gnas pa dang / rigs bzhi'i rig 'dzin pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa la snod ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la gsang ba chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gsal bar bstan cing bshad la/ de dag rnams kyis zab lam goms pas grol ba mnyes te/ skal ldan gyi mir gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams la ni/ so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams par ji lta ba bzhin du smin byed dbang gis smin par byas nas/ rgyud dang / lung dang / man ngag la sogs pa so sor gsungs nas/ smin grol gyi gang zag de dag rnams las rim kyis rab tu brgyud nas/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la sogs pa mi'i yul du dar bar gyur to/ /zhes bzhed la/ 'di dag gi nang gses gyi dbye ba dpag tu med pa yod mod kyang / 'di la 'di snyed yod do zhes rgyas par sus kyang brjod par spobs te brjod mi nus pas so/ /des na zab lam rdo rje theg pa dar tshul la/ /rnam mang mkhas pa'i bzhed srol mtha' yas kyang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas pa snga ma mang po'i bzhed srol mtha' yas pa'i nang nas rnam gzhag phyogs gcig tsam ston pa la/ gdul bya'i skal ba'i dbang bzhin du/ /sngon tshe thub pas sprul pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mngon par sprul mdzad nas/ /lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin dang / /mkha' 'gro sogs la gsang ba bshad/ /de dag rnams kyis skal ldan la/ /mi rnams la ni so so yi/ /skal ba ji bzhin smin byas nas/ /rgyud dang man ngag so sor gsungs/ /de dag rnams la rab brgyud nas/ /mi yi yul du gsal bar gyur/ /'di yi dbye ba dpag med phyir/ /'di snyed do zhes sus brjod spobs/ /zhes pa 'di byung / rgyu mtshan de ltar mkhas pa'i bzhed srol mang du yod mod kyi na'ang / rang lugs 'thad pa dang ldan pa ni/ gnyis pa tshad ldan gzhung dang sa skya pa'i/ /rje btsun mched kyi bzhed pa 'di lta ste/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyud sde spyi rnam la sogs pa rje btsun sku mched kyi gzhung lugs rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dag las gsung tshul hrug tsam phul na/ de yang bla med kyi rgyud sde phal che ba ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de nyid kyis rgya gar nub phyogs u rgyan gyi gnas mchog tu/ sprul pa mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po rab tu sprul nas rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti 'khor dang bcas pa smin par mdzad cing / gsang chen rgyud sde'i tshogs rnams legs par bshad/ dus de'i tshe 'khor dang ston pa tha mi dad pa'i tshul gyis dpal phyag na rdo rjes bla med kun bsdu bar mdzad/ slar yang gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes rgyud sde rnams gnas der rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la byin cing / de dag gis kyang dngos grub thob par gyur pas rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma zhes gsungs/ de nas u rgyan gyi yul de stong ste mtsho chen po klus yongs su gang bar gyur/ der yang phyag na rdo rjes rgyud rnams gser gyi glegs bam la baiḍūr+ya zhun mas bris te rgyud kyi glegs bam kun kyang mtsho chen po de'i klu rnams la gtad de/ klu rnams smin byed dbang gi sgo nas smin par mdzad/ de nas klu de rnams rim gyis mi'i gzugs su bsgyur te mtsho 'gram du grong khyer byas/ de dag gis rdo rje theg pa nyams su blangs pas phal cher gyis grub pa'i sa thob bud med rnams kyang phal che ba mkha' 'gro mar gyur te/ de'i phyir deng sang gi bar du yang u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas zhes grags pa yin la/ rgyu mtshan des na bla med gtso che ba rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti'i gsal bor byas tshul de ltar 'dra lags shing / rgyud sde 'og ma de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa phal che ba mi'i yul du dar tshul ni/

dpal sdom pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis nas/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /lha gnas gsum du grags pa de/ /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams na/ /dpal zhes ba'i ri bo la/ /thugs rje mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rjes gnang bar byed/ /mi las skal ldan pa dam pa zhig /byang chub mchog tu grub 'gyur bas/ /de la rtag tu gus par byos/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ lha gnas gsum du grags pa de/ /zhes pa ni de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud yin la/ de nyid rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi shar lho grong khyer pa ti kīrti zhes bya ba ru/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du rgyal po rab gsal zla ba la dbang bskur cing smin par mdzad/ rab gsal zla ba zhes bya ba'i rgyal po mchog des rgyud rnams mi'i yul du gsal bar byas/ zhes rang lugs 'thad ldan gsal bar ston par byed pa la/ de lta mod kyi bla med kyi/ /phal cher nub phyogs u rgyan du/ /in+d+ra bhu tis gsal bar byas/ /rgyud sde 'og ma phal che ba/ /phal pa'i yul gyi shar lho ru/ /rab gsal zla ba zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal po mchog gis gsal bar byas/ /zhes pa 'di byung / der ma zad byang sham+bha la la sogs pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can rnams su tsi lu pa la sogs pa'i skyes chen rnams kyis 'phags pa'i sa brnyes pa'i gang zag rnams las rgyud thos te mi'i yul du dar ba'i tshul kun tu gsal bar byas pa'ang yod/ ces zhar byung rgyud sde mi yul du dar tshul zhal 'phangs dang bcas te ston pa la/ tsi lu pa la sogs pa yis/ /sham+bha la la sogs pa ru/ /'phags pa rnams la thos pa'i tshul/ /kun tu gsal bar byas pa'ang yod/ /ces pa 'di byung / de la 'dir tsi lu pa zhes pa ste/ dus zhabs rnam gnyis kha che zla ba'i mgon/ zhes gsungs pa'i dus zhabs pa chen po dang don gcig pa yin te/

de skad du yang mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i dus 'khor chos 'byung chen mo las rigs ldan gyis rjes su bzung bas 'phags pa'i yul kun tu byang chub sems dpa'i chos skor dar bar mdzad pa slob dpon dus zhabs pa chen po ni rgya gar shar phyogs ba ren+t+rar/ yab gshin rje gshed nag po pa'i rnal 'byor pa bram ze bde byed dang / yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma pad+ma can gnyis kyis gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud las ci ltar byung ba bzhin rigs kyi sras bskrun pa'i cho ga byas pas/ yum gyi rmi lam du yum gyi lto bar 'phags pa 'jam dpal bzhugs pa rmis/ bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan dang bcas te 'khrungs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs pas blo rno ba dbang po gsal ba zhig byung / chung ngu la rab tu byung ste rig pa'i gnas ma lus pa tshegs med par mkhyen nas paṇ+ḍi tar gyur pas 'di la tsi lu pu zer/ paṇ+ḍi a tsar+ya las dus kyi 'khor lo gsan/ des kyang thugs ma tshim par sngon gyi smon lam sad pa'i mthus ci nas kyang sham+bha lar 'gro snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po skyes te/ thugs dam gyi lha sgrol ma la dngos su ci 'dod zhur yod pas/ des sham+bha la nas rgyud sde mang po dang sems 'grel rnams spyan drongs shig sems can la phan thogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan/ 'dzam bu'i gling nyid las byang du phyin na mya ngam gyi thang la zla ba bzhi 'gro dgos shing srog gi bar chad du 'gro bas/ phyi'i rgya mtsho la tshong pa dang lhan cig pa gzings la byon te/ tshong pa rnams nor bu'i gling du song / slob dpon gyis kyang byang phyogs su byon/ rgya mtsho'i gling gi ri zhig la 'dzegs te byon pas/ kha cig rigs ldan dpal skyongs zer/ kha cig pad+ma dkar po zhes zer ba'i rigs ldan gyi sprul mi dkar po gcig byung nas/ khyod gang nas 'ong / gang du 'gro/

ci la 'ong gsungs pa la/ nga rgya gar shar phyogs nas 'ong / byang sham+bha lar rigs ldan la dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos zhur 'gro byas pas/ yul der 'phags pa min pas gzhan sus kyang mi thar bas khyod kyi bgrod pa 'di lta bus bgrod par mi nus/ 'dir shes pa byung na nyan par byed dam gsungs pa dang / de rigs ldan gyi rnam 'phrul du mkhyen nas phyag dang skor ba mang du byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas bdag rjes su gzung du gsol ces zhus pas/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi 'gro ba rnams kyi ched du khyod nyid la dus kyi 'khor lo bstan pa'i phyir ngas 'dir 'ongs pa yin gyi nyon cig gsungs nas/ der chos kyi dbyings rnam pa thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du snang bar dbang rdzogs par bskur/ ches cher myur ba'i zab lam rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i gdams pa stsal/ ri de'i 'dabs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du zhag bdun bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes te rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la byon nas/ sham+bha la'i ma la ya tshal gyi dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor khang par rigs ldan dngos kyi zhabs la gtugs pas de nyid kyis dbang rdzogs par gnang / rgyud 'grel man ngag rnams bstan nas/ bsdus pa'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ 'grel chen dri med 'od/ rtsa rgyud dbang mdor bstan/ rang gzhan gyi lta ba mdor bsdus pa/ rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba/ don dam bsnyen pa/ bde mchog bstod 'grel/ rdo rje snying 'grel te byang chub sems dpa'i chos de rnams kyi dpe thams cad kyang gnang ste rgya gar shar phyogs me tog khyim du byon/ de nas yul dbus ma ga dhar byon nas ches bstan pas/ dus 'khor zhabs chen po zhes kun tu grags la/ sems 'grel skor 'phags pa'i yul shar nub kun du dar bar mdzad de sku sgyu lus ma spangs par mchog gi dngos grub brnyes so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags shing / 'dir sems 'grel skor zhes gsungs pa dang /

paṇa chen shāka mchog pas legs bshad gser thur las/ rgyud dang sems 'grel skor gsum las/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sems 'grel skor gsum po 'di/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa'i dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bde mchog stod 'grel/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje snying 'grel du grags pa rnams la ngos 'dzin nam snyam lags te/ gang na'ang blo gsal don gnyer dang ldan zhing dal 'byor chud ma zos par 'dod pa rnams kyis chos 'byung 'di lta bu la brten nas kyang dus 'khor gyi rgyud rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa dang / sems 'grel skor gsum ngos 'dzin pa dang / de rnams mi yul rgya gar rdo rje gdan du dar bar mdzad pa po tsi lu pa'am dus zhabs pa chen po nyid yin pa la sogs pa byang chub par mdzad pa cis kyang gal che ba lags/ de rnams kyis rgyud sde mi yul du dar tshul 'phros don dang bcas pa phul nas/ ༈ /da ni dri ba drug pa'i zhu tshig ni/ sems can grangs med sogs te/ de yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sems can dpag tu med pa 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i thabs la brtson par mdzad cing dpag tu med pa grol kyang / da dung 'khor ba'i sems can la 'phel 'grib med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhes dri ba zhus pa'i tshul de ston pa la/ sems can grangs med grol gyur kyang / /'khor ba 'phel 'grib med pa ci/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ 'phri dang bsnan pas sogs te/ de yang 'phri ba'am nyung du btang pas 'grib pa dang / bsnan pa'am mang du btang pas 'phel ba dang bcas pa ni tshad dang ldan pa'i dngos po 'ga' zhig la 'thad pa yin gyi/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam pa/

/sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can gyi khams la mtha' med cing grangs la tshad med pa'i phyir grol bas nyung bar ga la 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa las/ ma rig 'khrul 'khor 'di la zad med 'phel ba med/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /zhes pa'i zhus lan de gsal bar ston par byed pa la/ 'phri dang bsnan pa'i 'phel 'grib bcas/ /tshad ldan pa la 'thad pa ste/ sems can grangs la tshad med phyir/ /grol bas nyung bar ga la 'gyur/ /ces pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba bdun pa'i zhu tshig ni/ bar dor gnas pa'i zhes sogs te/ de yang srid pa bar dor gnas pa'i sems can de'i tshul lugs dang / /sems can de bar dor gnas pa'i yun ring thung la tshad mtha' gcig tu nges pa bdog lags sam/ zhes dri ba zhus pa'i tshul ston pa la/ bar dor gnas pa'i tshul lugs dang / /yun la tshad cig bdog lags sam/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston par byed pa la/ srid pa bar do sogs te/ de yang srid pa bar do'i sems can rnams ni skyes gnas bzhi'i nang nas rdzus skyes su skye ba ste/ dam pa'i chos mngon pa mdzod las/ mi dang dud 'gro rnam pa bzhi/ /srid pa bar ma brdzus te skye/ /yi dwags mngal nas skye ba'ang yod/ /ces brdzus skyes kho nar nges pas so/ /skye bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu ni zag bcas las kyi gzhan dbang kho nas skye ba ste/ rang gi sems kyi brtan so zin cing rang dbang rang gis thob na bar dor skye ba don med pa'i phyir/ bar do'i sems can de'i tshul lugs ni/ sngon byung srid pa'i sha gzugs can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngar gyi bag chags sad pa'i phyir sngar gang du skyes par gyur pa de'i cha byad dang gzugs brnyan can gcig tu snang / gal te gang zag stobs chen gzhan gyi thugs bskyed smon lam gyi mthus skye ba yongs su bsgyur bar byed na/

slar gang du skye bar 'gyur ba de dang / de'i gzugs su bar do'i sems can de yang yongs su gyur pa can yin no/ /zhes bar do'i sems can gyi tshul lugs ston pa la/ srid pa bar dor brdzus te skyes/ /skyes 'gyur las kyi gzhan dbang ste/ /da yi bag chags sngar sad phyir/ /gang du skye 'gyur byad gzugs can/ /gal te gang zag gzhan gyis mthus/ /skye ba yongs su sgyur byed na/ /gang du 'gyur ba de gzugs su/ /de'ang yongs su 'gyur ba can/ /zhes pa 'di byung / bar dor gnas pa'i yun tshad kyi dus ni mtha' gcig tu nges pa med de/ phal cher ni zhag bdun phrag gcig tu gnas shing / zhag bdun phrag bdun pa'am bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar du'ang gnas par yod ces grags la dge sdig las kyi 'phen pa'i drag zhan gyi dbang gis skad cig tsam las mi gnas pa dang / bar mtshams med par gnas pa'ang 'byung bar 'gyur zhing / skye gnas ma rnyed na lo'am bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa'ang bshad pa de'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa byed pa la/ dus ni phal cher zhag bdun no/ /bdun phrag bdun pa'ang yod ces grags/ /las kyi 'phen pa drag zhan gyis/ /mtshams med pa yang 'byung 'gyur zhing / /lo 'am bskal bar gnas pa'ang bshad/ /de phyir gcig tu nges pa med/ /ces pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba brgyad pa'i zhu tshig ni/ tshe 'di'i 'khri ba/ zhes sogs te/ de yang tshe 'dir snang gi 'khri ba gcod pa'i thabs/ lam nyams len tshul ji ltar byas na bde lags/ zhes dri ba zhus pa'i tshul ston pa la/ tshe 'di'i 'khri ba gcod pa'i thabs/ /nyams len ji ltar byas na bde/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston par byed pa ni/ sdug bsngal ba la/ zhes sogs te/ de la rgyud las/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /bskyed pas bsod nams dag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe 'di'i 'khri ba gcod pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa ni/

stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can nam thabs shes zung 'jug gam bden gnyis zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa nyid yin/ de'i tshul yang khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gsum gyis dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal ba'i rang bzhin can du shes shing / de dag sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi thabs snying rje chen po bsgom pa dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid la stong pa nyid du shes pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab bsgom pa dang / de ltar thabs shes zung 'jug bsgoms pas bde ba chen po'i 'bras bu sku gnyis zung 'jug thob par 'gyur/ des na 'bras bu de thob byed kyi thabs shes rab gnyis la bde ba'i rgyur shes na tshe 'di'i 'khri ba ci zhig yod de med pas 'khri ba rtsad nas gcod par 'gyur ro/ /de skad du yang 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis slob ma sku mched gsum la gdams pa las/ rten gyi gang zag gcig thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la/ lam gyi 'jug sgo dang bslab bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig yod kyang / rgyud la skye bar byed rgyu'i dngos po gcig las med/ gcig po de gang yin na/ stong pa snying rje'i snying po can yin/ stong pa ni don dam byang chub kyi sems te chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam gnas lugs ye nas skye med du rtogs pa de yin/ snying rje ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems te de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po skyes pa de yin/ des na theg pa chen po'i lam nyams su len pa rnams kyis dang po byang chub kyi sems gnyis po de rgyud la ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa'i thabs la 'bad cing / bar du yang byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la skye ba de nyid la sbyangs pas/ mtha' ma mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu chos sku dang gzugs sku gnyis mngon du thob nges pa yin no/

/zhes gsungs pas so/ /zhes pa'i zhus lan de gsal bar ston par byed pa la/ sdug bsngal ba la sdug bsngal dang / /stong pa nyid la stong nyid dang / /bde ba'i thabs la bde ba'i rgyu/ /shes na tshe 'di'i 'khri ba ci/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba dgu pa'i zhu tshig ni/ bka' brgyud bla ma sogs ste/ de yang bka' mdo rgyud bston bcos tshad ldan rnams nas gsungs pa'i bla ma dam pa'i zhabs thog sgrub pa'i tshul lam lugs la/ bstan pa'i rgyun spel ba'i phyir 'chad nyan la sogs pa'i sgo nas zhabs thog sgrub pa dang / longs spyod kyi mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ gser g.yu ja gos dar la sogs pa zang zing gi dngos po phul ba'i sgo nas zhabs thog sgrub pa rnams ji ltar spyad na zhabs thog gang 'grub che bar 'gyur lags/ zhes dri ba zhus tshul ston pa la/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i zhabs thog tu/ /tshul lugs ji ltar spyad na 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs tog sgrub pa dang / longs spyod kyis mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ gser g.yu ja gos dar la sogs pa zang zing gi dngos po phul ba'i sgo nas zhabs tog sgrub pa rnams ji ltar spyad na zhabs tog gang 'grub che bar 'gyur lags/ zhes dri ba zhus tshul ston pa la/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i zhabs tog tu/ /tshul lugs ji ltar spyad na 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ nus pa yod na zhes sogs te/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs tog sgrub tshul la/ mchog 'bring chung gsum rab 'bring tha gsum las/ de yang mchog ni/ theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan las/ de tshe chos kyi rgyun las ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la gzhi gnas dang / /ye shes yangs pa thob pa'i phyir/ /gdams ngag rgya chen rnyed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam thob nas chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i zhal mthong zhing chos thos pas/

zhi lhag zung 'jug gi gdams ngag la brten nas rang gi sems la brtan pa thob cing gzhan don bsgrub pa'i nus pa 'byung / de lta bu'i nus pas gzhan don byed nus pa'i mthu nus yod na/ lung chos dri ma med pa rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin du lhag bsam rnam dag gis kun nas bslangs/ gdul bya gzhan la phan pa'i don du gus rtag gi brtson 'grus dang ldan pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun mi nyams shing yun ring du gnas par byed pa'i thabs 'chad nyan yang dag par byed pa ni/ rtsa ba rgyud kyi bla ma dang rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes par byed pa'i tshul lugs dang po rab bam mchog de yin la/ rang gi sems kyis brtan sa ma zin pa'i rang rgyud ma smin/ mngon shes drug po gang rung dang mi ldan par gzhan don 'chad nyan la sogs pa byed pa ni/ dmus long gis ri dwags la mda' 'phen pa dang 'dra bas/ las dang po'i gang zag rang gis sems nyid 'dul ba gal che ste/ mkhas grub rin gsal gyi be bum sngon po las/ de ltar rang rgyud yongs su smin pa/ /las dang po yis gtso bor de bya/ /gzhan don gtso bor bya ba ma gnang / /lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul zhing gnas bya/ /zhes pa dang / yang de nyid las/ mngon shes med ring sems can don byed/ /dmus long ri dwags ming gi mda' 'phen/ /de bas tsab tsob nyung ba gtsor bya/ /zhes gsungs/ gal te mngon shes dang mi ldan pas gzhan don bshad nyan sogs gtan nas mi rung ngam snyam na/ gtso bor zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pa dang / gzhan yang / gzhan phan las la mthu med na/ /de yi bsam pa rtag tu bya/ /gang la bsam pa de yod pa/ /de ni de la don gyis zhugs/ /zhes pa dang / be bum sngon po las kyang / sems kyi sems can don las gzhan med/ /lus dang ngag gis dngos su 'jug min/ zhes gsungs pas/ gdul bya gzhan la 'chad nyan la sogs pa dngos su gzhan don sgrub pa'i nus mthu med pa'am cung zad yod kyang dman par gyur na/

gzhan phan gyi bsam pa dang ldan par rang nyid bsnyen sgrub la gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus dang bcas pas rang don la rtse gcig gzhol bar byed pa ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma dang rgyal ba sras dang bcas mnyes par byed pa'i tshul lugs gnyis pa yin no/ /'di yang gzhan don byed pa'i nus pa yod med dang bstan pa'i rgyun lta bu la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin gyis/ gzhan gzhung lugs phal cher las/ sgrub pa'i zhabs tog nyid rab dang gtso bor gsungs pa mang shing / sgrub pa'i zhabs tog ces pa'i sgrub pa de yang / bsnyen sgrub ces pa'i sgrub pa dang / sgrub mchod ces pa'i sgrub pa gnyis yin la/ 'di dag gi sgo nas bla ma mnyes par byed pa'i zhabs tog gi gtso bor gsungs te/ rje rgod tshang pa chen po'i zhal snga nas/ bla ma mnyes par byed pa la/ /zhabs tog rnam pa gsum yin te/ /rab kyi sgrub pa'i zhabs tog dang / /'bring po lus kyi zhabs tog dang / /mtha' ma zang zing zhabs tog go /zhes gsungs/ de yang sher phyin gyi mdo las/ rten de chos kyi bgo skal la spyod yon tan ldan/ /bshes gnyen rab tu bsten byed zang zing min/ /zhes pa dang / yang mdo las/ zang zing mchod pa dpag med pas/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pa skad cig mchog /de yis nga ni mnyes byas kyi/ /snga mas mnyes par byas ma yin/ /zhes pa dang / rje bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyang / lus dka' thub spyad de bsgoms lags pas/ /nyams cung zad rgyud la skyes pa yod/ /pha sku drin che bas sems la dran/ /drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal ba yang dgon pa chen pos kyang / rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa yi/ /bsnyen bkur gyi gtso bor sgrub pa yin/ /bla ma mnyes pa'i zhabs tog tu/ /zang zing khab gcig med kyang chog /ces gsungs pa yin la/ de ltar gzhan don 'chad nyan dang sgrub pa'i cha nas zhabs tog bsgrub par ma nus na/

lus longs spyod zang zing gi dngos po'i sgo nas bla ma dang rgyal ba mnyes par byed pa de ni/ sngar gyi mchod pa de gsum gyi nang nas chung ngu yin par gsungs kyang / spyir ni zang zing gi mchod pa yang phan yon chen po dang ldan par gsungs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ bla ma la dus dus su chu snod re tsam phul na'ang bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob/ ces pa la sogs pa lung tshad med pas grub pa yin/ zhes zhus lan de gsum du dbye ba dang bcas ston pa la/ nus pa yod na chos bzhin du/ /gzhan don brtson pas bstan pa'i rgyun/ /gnas par byed pa bla ma dang / /rgyal ba mnyes byed dang po yin/ /gzhan don sgrub pa'i mthu dman na/ /sgrub la brtson pas rang don la/ /gzhol ba mnyes byed gnyis pa yin/ /zang zing gis mchod gsum pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba bcu pa'i zhu tshig ni/ dben par nyin re byed pa dang / /bshad nyan byed pa gang khyad 'phags/ /zhes pa ste/ de yang dben zhing nyams dga' la rje btsun gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog dam par/ thabs shes zung 'jug gis zin pa'i nyams len khyad par can la lus sems rtse gcig tu bsgrim pa'i sgo nas brtson par byed pa dang / don gnyer can gyis 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su/ mdo rgyud zab mo nas gsungs pa'i gsung rab rnams la nyan bshad tshul bzhin du byed pa gtso che zhing khyad par gang 'phags pa lags/ zhes dri ba zhus pa'i tshul ston pa la/ dben par sogs byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ dang por sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sogs te/ de yang spyir don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la de gnyis char khyad par du 'phags shing med du mi rung ba yin mod/ 'on kyang snyigs ma lnga phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin do bdo ba'i dus 'dir/ shes ldan skal bzang gi grogs po kun kyang / /blo dang dbang po rnams gsal ba'i dus su/

/'bad pas gsung rab la thos bsam mdzod cig /'di phyir phan pa yi snying gtam lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po na so gzhon pa dang blo dang dbang po kun kyang gsal ba'i skabs der/ tshad ldan gyi gsung rab khyad par can la brten nas thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa nyid ci nas kyang gal che ste/ thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs ma bcad par thos bsam las byung ba'i shes rab skye ba med/ de med par bsgom pa'i tshul mi shes pas bsgom pa bsam gtan nam ting nge 'dzin skye ba med/ de med par bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab skye ba med/ de med par bdag med mngon sum mthong zin rgyun ldan du bsgom pa'i bsam gtan skye ba med/ de med par bsgom pa mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung bas so/ /rgyu mtshan de bas na thog mar thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs legs par bcad de/ thos byung dang bsam byung gi shes rab kyi ngo bo tshogs lam bskyed/ de nas thos bsam gyis bsgom pa las byung ba gtso bor gyur pa bsgom byung gi shes rab kyi ngo bo sbyor lam bskyed/ shes rab de gsum la brten nas bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi ngo bo mthong lam bskyed/ de nas de mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i shes rab kyi ngo bo sgom lam bskyed/ de mthar phyin pa la brten nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gnag rjes kyi chu ltar 'tshal ba'i thar ba thob par bya dgos te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi dbu ma bshes springs las/ shes rab med la bsam gtan yod min te/ /bsam gtan med par yang ni shes rab med/ /gang la de gnyis yod pa srid pa yi/ /rgya mtsho gnag rjes lta bur 'tshal bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gal te thos pa ma byas par lus sems rtse gcig tu bsgrims te sgom kho na la bzhugs na thar pa gsum po gang yang rung ba thob par 'gyur ro snyam na/ mi 'gyur te/

rje btsun rin po ches/ la la thos pa med par bsgom/ /thos pa med pa ci bsgom mam/ /zhes thos pa gtan nas ma byas par bsgom tshul mi shes pas bsgom rgyu med par gsungs shing / der ma zad skyes rabs las/ thos chung dmus long bsgom pa'i tshul mi shes/ /shes rab rgyas byed pa ni thos pa yin/ /zhes thos pa rgya chung ngus kyang bsgom tshul mi shes pas/ bsgom byung gi shes rab bskyed pa la thos pa rgya chen po dgos par gsungs pa dang / yang skyes rabs las/ thos pa ma rig mun sel sgron me ste/ /rkun po la sogs mi 'phrog nor gyi mchog /ces sogs thos pa bya dgos par bde bar gshegs pas mang du bstan pa rnams don med du 'gyur ba las/ de dag don med ma yin par don khyad par can dang ldan pa yin pas so/ /don 'di la dgongs nas rje btsun byams mgon gyis mdo sde rgyan las/ gal te ma thos par yang bsgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa'ang don med 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / de ltas bde bar gshegs kyi bstan pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /zhes gsungs pa yin lags/ de la gal te 'o na thos pa rkyang pas thar pa gsum po gang yang rung ba thob par 'gyur ram snyam na/ de yang mi 'gyur te/ rje btsun rin po ches/ la la mi tshe thos par 'byams/ /bsgom med yid la ci 'chang ngam/ /zhes ma byas pa'i thos rkyang des 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe blo la sbar bcang du 'chang rgyu med pas don chung bar gsungs pa dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis pa'i zhal snga nas/ mi tshe thos par bskyal kyang don go chung / /zhes thos pa ril pos mi tshe bskyal kyang dgos pa'i tshe don chung bar gsungs pa dang / yang rje btsun rin po ches/ sgom pa nyams len byed tsam na/ /sgom med sgom pa po'ang med/ /yul med mtha' bral sgom pa de/ /bya ba thongs la nyams su longs/ /zhes 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab dang / lta ba spros bral gyis zin pa'i sgom nyams su longs zhes gdams par mdzad pa dang /

mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ don dam gzigs par bgyi slad dngos rnams la/ /tshul bzhin yid la bgyi ba de goms mdzod/ /ces don dam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i phyir du/ dngos po rnams kyi gnas tshul la tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa rnal 'byor can rnams kyis rnal 'byor du byed dgos par gsungs pa rnams don med du 'gyur ba las/ de dag don med ma yin par don khyad par can dang ldan pas so/ /don 'di dag la dgongs nas yang rje btsun byams mgon gyis/ gal te ma bsgom par yang thos 'jug 'gyur na sgom pa don med 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / de ltar rnal 'byor can gyi bsgom pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs thos rkyang dang sgom rkyang du song ba ma yin par/ thog mar gzhung lugs tshad ldan la brten nas thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ bcad don bsgom pa nyams su blangs te thos bsam sgom gsum zung 'brel du byed dgos par/ thos med sa phug tu 'gog pa sgrub dang / /thos bsam shes rab kyi gru skya bzung nas/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho nas nor bu len pa/ /blun pos bltas na lta snga ma legs te/ /don gnyis mthar phyin gyi sangs rgyas rgyu la/ /thos sgom zung 'brel du dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad las mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa legs na'ang / cung zad rgyas dogs pas/ des na 'dir skabs su bab pa gzhung don dngos la 'jug pa skabs su babs pas/ de yang 'jug sgo dang por thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang / gzhan gang zag gi rigs la gzhan don gtso bor sgrub pa la gzhol zhing gzhan don byed nus pa dang / rang don gtso bor sgrub pa la gzhol zhing gzhan don che cher byed mi nus gnyis las/ snga ma gzhan don gtso bor sgrub na thos bsam sgom gsum sngon du btang ste bshad nyan sgrub gsum dang /

'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la sogs pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la bya ba rgya chen po bya dgos te/ de ltar byed pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa tshangs par spyod/ /yongs su rdzogs par thub pas gsung de'i phyir/ /skyes bu dam pa bsten bgyi rgyal ba la/ /brten nas rab tu mang pos zhi ba thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten nas tshangs spyod kyi lus yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir skyes bu dam pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bgyi ste/ dper na rgyal ba yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa bsten pa la brten nas lnga sde bzang po la sogs pa bgrangs ba las 'das pa du ma rnams kyi srid pa'i sdug bsngal zhi ba'i zhi ba thar pa thob pa bzhin/ zhes pa'i don dang mthun par rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi gtso bo yin zhing / de'i rjes su 'o skol gyis phyis 'jug rnams kyis kyang ci nus su 'jug dgos pas so/ /gang zag gi rigs phyi ma rang don gtso bor sgrub pa la gzhol zhing / gzhan don ches cher byed mi nus pa dang / dang po'i na so yol te phyi nas lag 'tsho rgas pa rnams kyi ni/ lang 'tsho yol ba rnams kyi gnas sa bde/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang brgyud kyi nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rnams gong 'phel du bskyed pa dang / rang don mos pa bsgom lam ltar rang don gzhan don gnyis kyi nang nas rang gi don byed pa la/ zab mo nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba mchog yin te/ de ltar yin par rje bla ma ngor pa rdo rje 'chang yab sras gsum sogs kyis/ sgrub pa po rnams g.yeng ba kun spangs zhing / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang / nyon mongs skye ba'i gnas dang grogs spangs zhing / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang / don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng zhing / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis sogs kyis legs par grub pa'i phyir/

rgyu mtshan de lta bas na/ khyed dang zhes nye tshig dang sbyar ba'i sgar tshig gi 'bod pa ste/ lang tsho yol ba'i dri ba zhu ba po khyed dang / gzhan yang rigs dang lang tsho sogs khyod 'dra ba gzhan gang yin pa dag gis kyang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems/ rim gnyis zab mo bsgom pa sogs sgrub pa nyams len la rtse gcig tu nan tan bya bar ci nas kyang rigs so/ /zhes pa'i zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ dang por sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang / /gzhan don sgrub na bshad nyan bya/ /phyi nas rtogs pa bskyed pa dang / /rang gi don la sgrub pa mchog /khyod dang khyod 'dra gang yin pas/ /sgrub la nan tan bya bar rigs/ /zhes pa 'di byung ba yin la/ ༈ /dri ba bcu gcig pa'i zhu tshig ni/ bsam gtan bzlas brjod sogs te/ de yang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las dbang lung man ngag bshad pa/ khrid bka' rnams legs par thob cing / thob don rang nyid kyis nyams su blangs te nyams rtogs cung zad skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/ nyams rtogs de'i gegs sel bogs 'don du/ bsam gtan bsgom pa la gnas te gsang sngags bzlas brjod kyi rim pa yengs med du byed pa dang / mdo rgyud bstan bcos sogs gzhung lugs tshad ldan la blta rtog byed pa gnyis gang khyad che lags/ zhes dri ba zhus pa'i tshul ston pa la bsam gtan bzlas brjod byed pa dang / /gzhung lugs blta ba gang bogs che/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ dngos gzhi bsam gtan sogs te/ de yang nyams rtogs kyi sna kha zin pa'i rnal 'byor pa de lta bus/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bsgom pa'i skabs su/ mnyam bzhag bsam gtan de'i ngang dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas gsang sngags bzlas brjod byed pa la brtson par bya dgos te/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing / /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes yi dam lha'i thugs rgyud bskul te yi dam lha de sgrub pa la/

yi dam de'i gsang sngags de ma bzlas par yi dam de mi 'grub cing / gsang sngags de'i 'bras bu yang sbyin sreg ma byas par 'byin mi nus pa/ zhes gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir/ gsang sngags de lta bu bzla ba'i tshul yang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun/ /yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang / /sems gzhan g.yeng bas byas pa ni/ /de nyid rigs pas don med gsungs/ /zhes gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod byed pa dang / bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la gsol 'debs sogs kyi tshig brjod pa dang bsnyung gnas la sogs pa'i sgo nas lus kyi dka' thub spyod pa la sogs pa lus ngag gi bya ba kun kyang / lhag bsam rnam dag dang nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa'am/ des ma zin kyang sgo gsum 'jug pa rtse gcig tu bsgrims te gzhan du ma yengs par bya dgos te/ de ltar ma yin par sems gzhan du g.yengs pa'i sgo nas lus ngag gi bzlas brjod dka' thub sogs lo dang bskal pa sogs yun ring po'i bar du byas kyang / byas pa don med lta bur chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid rigs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mdo las/ sems g.yengs bas ni bdag gi don yang mi 'grub na/ gzhan gyi don lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes gsungs pas 'grub/ ces pa'i don du snang bas/ mtha' na'ang tshig rjes su sems bcug ste ma yengs pa'i sgo nas bzla bar bya dgos la/ gal te bzlas pa nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu bzlas pa sogs yun ring ba'i stobs kyis lus ngag gnyis ngal zhing dub pa dang / yid skyo ba dang / yang bzlas brjod ci ltar byas kyang spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ni gang yang skye bar mi 'dug snyam pa'i skyo shas drag po byung ba dang / de ltar ma yin kyang 'khor gyi log sgrub lta bu la brten nas sems skyo bar gyur na/ de lta bu'i skyo ba bsal ba dang / yang bskyed rdzogs bzlas bzla sogs la dag gam ma dag gam/

yin nam ma yin nam snyam pa la sogs pa'i the tshom skyes na de lta bu'i the tshom bsal ba dang / gzhan la skyabs gnas dam pa bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang bcas pa la dad pa 'grib na de bsal te dad pa bskyed pa dang / yang der ma zad/ gal te mtho ris thar pa mngon zhen na/ /yang dag lta la goms pa nyid du mdzod/ /gang dag log par lta bas legs spyad kyang / /thams cad rnam par smin pa mi zad ldan/ /zhes dbu ma bshes springs las gsungs pa ltar/ 'jig rten yang dag blta ba las rgyu 'bras la bden nam mi bden snyam pa'i the tshom mam/ mi bden snyam du 'dzin pa'i log lta can gyis legs spyad dge ba'i tshul spyad kyang / las dkar rnam smin gnag pa zhes bya ba rnam smin sdug bsngal zad mi shes pa myong dgos pas/ des na rab thar pa chen po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'bring nyan rang gi byang chub/ mtha' ma bde 'gro mtho ris lha yi lus rten tsam thob par byed pa la yang / tha snyad du las rgyu 'bras bden par shes pa byas te blang dor tshul bzhin du bya dgos par gsungs pa de bas na/ las rgyu 'bras la mi bden par 'dzin pa'i log lta skyes tshe/ de lta bu'i log lta bsal te tha snyad du las rgyu 'bras bden par nges shes bskyed pa sogs kyi dgos pa'i phyir/ thun mtshams kyi bar skabs bar skabs dag tu/ byang chub sems mchog bsgom pa'i thun mtshams su/ mdo bklags dkon mchog mchod la brtson par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ston pa'i mdo sde la sogs pa'i gzhung lugs tshad ldan rnams la blta ba dang / kha don sogs byed pa yang gal che ste/ de dag la brten nas rang rgyud kyi nyams rtogs rnams gegs sel bogs 'don gyi sgo nas gong 'phel du 'gyur bas so/ /zhes zhus lan de gsal bar bstan pa la/ dngos gzhi bsam gtan bzlas brjod brtson/ /skyo dang the tshom bsal ba dang / /dad dang nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir/

/bar skabs dag tu gzhung lugs blta/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba bcu gnyis pa'i zhu tshig ni/ mdo sogs kha 'don zhes sogs te/ de yang mnyam gzhag bsam gtan bsgom pa dang / rjes thob gzhung lugs sogs blta ba mnyam gzhag ting nge 'dzin gal che ba lags na/ rjes thob rang gi skabs/ 'jam sdud bzang gsum gyi mdo la sogs pa'i mdo sde zab mo klog cing kha 'don byed pa dang / bde kyai gsang gsum la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi bzla bya'i sngags rnams 'dren pa sdig sbyong dge spel sogs la gang khyad par du 'phags shing gtso gang che lags/ zhes dri ba zhu ba'i tshul ston pa la/ mdo sogs kha 'don byed pa dang / /sngags kyi bzlas pa'i khyad par gang / /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ klog pa dang ni sogs te/ de yang bsam pa rnam par dag cing sems tha mal du ma yengs pa'i sgo nas mdo sogs kyi klog pa kha 'don dang / rtsa sngags snying po/ nye snying sogs kyi bzlas pa bya ba gang yang khyad par 'phags mod/ de'i nang nas kyang gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod nyid khyad par du 'phags shing phan yon che bar grub ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon pos dbang byas te/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud rgyas pa 'bum pa'i lung tshul gsum sgron mar drangs pa ltar/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las khyad chos bzhi'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs la/ de'i dbang gis phar phyin pa'i nyams len las/ rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len khyad par du 'phags pa 'bad med du grub pa dang / der ma zad/ dang por gnyis te mchod 'os sam/ /yang na yi ge rab nyung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brjod bya'i don gcig nyid khyad med du ston pa'i yi ge mang nyung gnyis nyung ba khyad par du 'phags shing /

brjod bya khyad par du ston pa'i mdo tshig phal cher las gsang sngags kyi tshig phal cher nyung ba ka shas che ste/ dper na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje gcod pa'i mdo bam po gcig tsam pa de ston pa las/ de'i snying po/ na moḥbha ga wa te pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta ya/ zhes pa sh+lau ka gnyis tsam pa de ston pa phan yon che bar rdo rje gcod pa'i mjug nyid du/ rdo rje gcod pa'i snying po 'di lan gcig bklags na/ rdo rje gcod pa khri dgu stong bklags pa dang mnyam par 'gyur/ zhes gsal bar gsungs pas 'grub pa des na/ mdo sde zab mo klog pa dang kha ton du 'don pa bas ni/ gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod nyid phan yon che zhing khyad par du 'phags so/ /zhes zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ klog pa dang ni kha ton pas/ /bzlas brjod phan yon che bar gsungs/ /zhes pa 'di byung / /dri ba bcu gsum pa'i zhu tshig ni/ rtse gcig bsgrub pa byed pa sogs te/ de yang tshe 'dir snang ba'i bya ba thams cad btang ste lus sems rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas thar lam bsgrub par byed pa la/ lam gyi gzhi gang la brten te lam la 'jug tshul dang / sa lam bgrod tshul sogs gang gi sgo nas ji ltar byas na bde/ zhes dri ba zhus tshul de ston pa la/ rtse gcig sgrub pa byed pa la/ /lam gyis bgrod tshul gang gis bde/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ dam tshig sdom pa'i sogs te/ de yang spyir thar lam sgrub tshul gyi rnam gzhag mang du yod mod kyang / 'dir nye lam bla med rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub tshul gyi dbang du bgyis na/ thog mar rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rigs dam par sku 'khrungs pa'i skyes chen dam pa lta bu'i rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la/ dad gus don gnyer dang ldan pas smin byed dbang bzhis rang rgyud legs par smin par byas/

de nas dbang dus su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams rang gi mig 'bras bzhin du gces par bsrung ba'i sgo nas sangs rgyas sgrub byed kyi gzhi 'am rtsa ba dam tshig brtan par bya dgos te/ 'di med na 'gram rtsa zhig pa'i khang rul bzhin du lam gang bsgoms kyang / phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub par mi nus pas so/ /de skad du yang / 'khrul pa'i dri ma ma lus par spangs pa rje btsun rin po ches/ rdo rje theg la dad kyang ma smin na/ /zab mo bsgoms kyang 'bras bu ngan 'gro las/ /mchog gzhan mi 'grub sangs rgyas gsungs pas na/ /bla ma mchog la dbang bskur nod par mdzod/ /dbang thob man ngag zab mo 'tshal ba yi/ /sa steng rgyas par kun du btsal byas kyang / /phan pa'i don po man ngag dam tshig ste/ /'di med 'gram rtsa zhig pa'i khang rul bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de ltar gzhi brtan par byas shing de'i rjes su lam la 'jug pa'i tshul la/ rgya chen spyod pa'i rim pa dang / zab mo sgrub pa'i rim pa gnyis sam/ thabs rgya chen po sgrub pa'i rim pa dang / shes rab zab mo sgrub pa'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro legs par sngon du btang nas/ de rjes snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal zhing snang la rang bzhin med par shes pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste rim gnyis zung 'jug gi mnyam gzhag la legs par gnas pa bya dgos te/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba las/ des na smin byed dbang dang ni/ /rim pa gnyis la 'bad par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa yin la/ de ltar bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi mnyam gzhag las langs nas/ de'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su'ang de'i rgyun dang 'brel bar bdag gzhan thams cad lhar rig pa'i sgo nas/ lhas lha la mchod pa'i tshul du longs spyod kyi dngos po sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas mchod pa dang /

gsang sngags kyi bzlas pa zab mos rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing / gzhan yang sbyin sogs kyi dge ba rgya chen po bsgrub la/ de dag kun kyang bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs nas bsngo ba dang / smon lam rnam par dag pa bzang pos rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur yongs su sgyur bar byed pa ni thabs rgya chen pos bla med byang chub bsgrub pa'i rim pa lags la/ gnyis pa zab mo bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ kun mkhyen bla ma mkhas pa'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ phyi nang dngos kun rang sems snang ba tsam/ /sems nyid ngo bo nyid med sgyu ma bzhin/ /de yang spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba yis/ /dbang gi mtshon pa'i lta ba rtogs par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang gi sems de dang der snang ba tsam ma gtogs/ rang gi sems las logs su grub pa'i ngo bo yud tsam yang med la/ rang gi sems nyid kyang gdod ma nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad bral ba/ rang bzhin gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i chos sku'i ngo bor gnas pa de nyid dang / bla ma'i thugs dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rnams gnyis su med par dbyer med ro gcig tu shes par byas nas dus rtag tu de ka'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ lta ba zab mo spros bral la 'jug cing bsgrub pa'i rim pa yin zhes dngos kyi zhus lan ston pa la/ dam tshig sdom pa'i gzhi brtan cing / /bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas nas/ /rjes thob bdag gzhan lhar rig pas/ /longs spyod pa yi mchod pas mchod/ /sngags kyis rgyal ba'i thugs bskul zhing / /dge kun gzhan gyi don dmigs nas/ /smon lam bzang pos yongs bsgyur ba/ /rgya chen bsgrub pa'i rim pa ste/ /rang sems gdod nas rnam dag pa/ /bla ma'i thugs dang gnyis med par/ /shes nas rtag tu mnyam 'jog pa/ /zab mo bsgrub pa'i rim pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung /
