de ltar rim gnyis blta ba dang bcas pa gtso bor brten pa sems la gnad du bsnun nas nyams su len pa de lta bu'am/ yang rten lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i thabs rtsa thig rlung gsum la brten pa sogs shin tu zab cing mchog tu gyur pa mang du yod mod kyi/ 'on kyang de dag ni lang tsho yol ba rnams kyis bsgrub pa'ang dka' zhing gegs sel sogs bogs 'don byed pa dngos su med na gegs kyang mang bas re zhig mos pa'i yul tsam du byas la/ nyams su blang bya'i gtso bo gong du bstan pa la 'bad par bya dgos so/ /zhes zhar las byung ba'i lan gdab pa'i tshul gyis gsal bar ston pa la/ lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs/ /shin tu zab pa yod mod kyi/ /sgrub par dka' zhing gegs mang bas/ /re zhig mos pa tsam du bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba bcu bzhi pa'i zhu tshig ni/ lam la 'bad pa sogs so/ /de yang gong du bstan pa'i zab lam de lta bu la 'bad rtsol chen po dang bcas te 'jug par byed pa'i tshe/ nyin zhag phrugs re la dge sbyor gyi khrigs chags lta bu'i tshul du byas te ci ltar nyams su blang bar bgyi lags/ zhes dri ba zhus pa'i tshul ston pa la/ lam la 'bad pa byed pa'i tshe/ /dge sbyor khrigs chags ji ltar bgyi/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ tho rangs rlung sems sogs te/ de yang spyir mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams nas nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi dge sbyor bya ba'i rim pa mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs kyang / 'dir/ mnyam par gzhag dang ma gzhag rnal 'byor bcu/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnal 'byor bcu'i sgo nas nyin zhag phrugs gcig dge sbyor gyi bya bas 'dar ba'i dbang du byas na/ thog mar dgos pa'i dbang gi mnyam bzhag bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa'i sgo nas bsgom par bya ste/ de ltar bsgom pa'i dgos pa nyams rtogs skye ba'i ched yin la/

tho rangs kyi dus su rlung sems dwangs bas ting nge 'dzin skye sla ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa la/ tho rangs rlung sems dwangs pa'i phyir/ /zab mo'i ting 'dzin bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / mnyam gzhag de'i rjes su rnal 'byor bcu'i go rim bzhin thog mar ldang ba'i rnal 'byor bya ste/ de yang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang mthun par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gang yang rung bas langs nas/ dus dang bstun pa'i chus khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas sdig sgrib bshags pa/ gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba/ don dam byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par dam bca' ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa/ dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba ste/ rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa'i/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lta bu'i tshig brjod pa dang bcas te/ yan lag bdun pas bdag rgyud sbyangs shing dag par byas/ de rjes/ kha zas sman dang 'dra bar rig pa yis/ /'dod chags zhe sdang med par bsten bgyi ste/ /rgyags phyir mi lags snyems pa'i phyir ma lags/ /tshags phyir ma lags lus gnas 'ba' zhig phyir/ /zhes mgon po klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje'i lus skyon med pa yun ring du gnas shing 'tsho ba'i phyir/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor bsten pa'i chos nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin kha zas la legs par longs spyad de/ de na nyin bar gyi gnas skabs su mdo sogs kha 'don byed pa dang / bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor man ngag nas 'byung ba bzhin gsang sngags bzlas brjod byed pa dang / de bzhin du mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor lha dang 'byung po tha dad tha mi dad sogs skabs dang sbyar ba'i nang gtor/ gzhan yang phyi gtor chu sbyin dang bcas pa/ der ma zad phyag dang skor ba la sogs pas gtso bor lus ngag gi dge sbyor la 'bad pa dang bcas pa lus ngag don yod par bya dgos so zhes ston pa la/

langs nas khrus sogs sngon 'gro bas/ /yan lag bdun pas bdag rgyud sbyang / /chos bzhin kha zas legs spyad de/ /nyin bar kha 'don bzlas brjod dang / /gtor ma chu sbyin la sogs pa/ /gtso bor lus ngag dge sbyor bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de nas srod kyi dus la bab pa'i tshe thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgom pa'i sgo nas gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad tshar gcad par bya dgos te/ sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar de/ /rjes 'jug sgrub po'i nyams len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon gyi dus su yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas bdud tshogs sde dang bcas pa srod la btul zhing tshar bcad nas tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa bzhin du/ 'o skol rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang de bzhin byas pas/ srod la bdud dang log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod sla zhing bar chad thams cad zhi nas myur du sangs rgya ba'i rten 'brel 'grig par 'gyur bas so/ /zhes ston pa la/ srod la thub pas bdud btul phyir/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom nas/ zhes pa 'di byung / de dang de dang 'brel bar mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rim gnyis bsgom pa bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas mdun gyi nam mkhar gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ting nge 'dzin gyis gsal bar dmigs te/ de dag las bdag 'jug gi tshul du dbang bzhi bskur ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu blang bar bya ste/ de ltar byas pas rang rgyud kyi nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad dag par 'gyur bar gsungs pas so/ /zhes ston pa la/ rim gnyis bzlas bcas sngon 'gro bas/ /mdun gyi ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang bskur rin chen blang bar bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i rjes su nyal ba'i rnal 'byor rang bzhin 'od gsal stong pa'i ngang las nyal ba dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho lta bu ni gnyid log pa'i tshe na'ang dran pas gang zin byas nas bsgom par bya la/

rmi lam 'dzin pa'i 'dun ma sngon du btang ste de yi ngang nas rmi lam gyi gnas skabs kun tu yang chos rnams thams cad rmi lam nyid du shes par bya zhing / gnyid log pa'i gnas skabs der gzhan yang yi dam gyi lha dang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / bdag nyid rjes su dran pa'i rjes dran rnam pa gsum dran pa la 'bad par bya dgos so/ /zhes ston pa la/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i/ /'chi kha ma yi gdams ngag ni/ /gnyid log tshe na'ang bsgom bya zhing / /'dun pa sngon du 'gro ba yi/ /rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam nyid du shes bya zhing / /der yang lha dang bla ma dang / /bdag nyid rjes su dran par bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de lta bu'i nyams len gyis zin pa'i gnyid las sad pa'i tshe na sngar gyi nyal ba'i rnal 'byor rang bzhin ni 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang de las/ gsal stong zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i skur ldang bar bya/ gzhan yang rgyud kyi rnal 'byor dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma snying kha dang spyi bor 'bral med du bsgom pa ni lam nyams len gyi gnad kyi snying po dam pa yin no/ /zhes ston pa la/ sad pa'i tshe na 'od gsal las/ /zung 'jug chen por ldang bar bya/ /dus rnams kun tu bla ma dang / /'bral med lam gyi snying po yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de rnams kyi don bsdu ba ni de ltar nyin zhag phrugs re la rnal 'byor bcu nyams su len pa'i rim pa 'dis/ rnal 'byor pa rnams zla ba dang lo tsam ma yin par byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'da' bar bya dgos so/ /zhes mjug bsdu ba'i tshul gyis sngar gyis dri ba'i lan gsal bar ston pa la/ tho rangs rlung sems dwangs pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ nyams su len pa'i rim pa 'dis/ /rnal 'byor dus kun 'da' bar bya/ /zhes pa'i bar rnams byung / ༈ /dri ba bco lnga pa'i zhu tshig ni/ bskyed rim rtog pa yin pas zhes sogs te/

de yang / tha mal rnam rtog bsgyur ba la/ /bskyed rim ming du btags pa yin/ /zhes tha mal gyi rnam rtog lha'i rnam par bsgyur cing lhar zhen blo la bskyed rim du btags par gsungs pa dang / bskyed rim rtog pa yin mod kyi/ /zhes sogs bskyed rim rtog pa yin par gsungs shing / yang rtog pas mthong ba 'ching ba ste/ de ni 'di ru dgag par bya/ /zhes pa dang / yang / mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas na rtog pas 'ching bar 'gyur ba dang / mi rtog pas grol bar 'gyur bya ba yin lags na/ 'dir bskyed rim grol ba'i thabs lam khyad par can du gsungs la ji ltar lags/ zhes dri ba zhu ba'i tshul ston pa la/ bskyed rim rtog pa yin pas na/ /'ching 'gyur bya ba ji ltar lags/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ bskyed rim rtog pa sogs te/ de nas spyi ldog nas bskyed rim la rtog pas ma khyab cing / rang ldog la bskyed rim rtog pa yin par khas blangs pas chog mod kyi/ 'on kyang rtog pa la thabs mkhas khyad par can gyis zin ma zin gyi bye brag gis/ 'ching grol gyi rgyur 'gyur ba so sor yod de/ thabs mkhas khyad par can gyis ma zin pa'i tha mal gyi rtog pas 'ching ba'i rgyu byed par/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ tha mal rnam rtog rgyu ni ma rtogs pa/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba gzhan ci'ang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa dang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ 'dir ni sdug bsngal rgyur gyur pa'i/ /bden par zhen pa bzlog bya yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /thabs mkhas khyad par can gyis zin pa'i rtog pas tha mal gyi rtog pa sel bar byed cing grol ba'i thabs kyi mchog kyang byed pa yin te/ dper na khyi'us khyi'u 'byin pa'am dri mas dri ma sel bar byed pa bzhin yin pas so/ /de skad du rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis/

/skye bo thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dug gi de nyid shes pa des/ /dug gis dug ni 'bigs par byed/ /ces pa nas/ skye bo mi zad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar tshigs su bcad pa lnga lhag tsam gyi don/ bskyed rim zab mo nyid/ gnyen por che ba lnga'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs tshul gsungs pa rnams kyis 'grub pa yin no/ /zhes dris lan rnams gsal bar ston pa la/ bskyed rim rtog pa yin mod kyi/ /khyi'us khyi'u 'byin pa bzhin/ /rtog pas rtog pa sel bar byed/ /grol ba'i thabs kyi mchog yin no/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba bcu drug pa'i zhu tshig ni/ rig pa'i dbang lnga zhes sogs te/ de yang mi bskyod pa chu dbang la sogs pa'i chos can rig pa'i dbang lnga bla mas slob ma la bskur ba'i tshe dbang rdzas bum pa'i chu la sogs pa lnga dang / lha mi bskyod pa la sogs pa lnga mtshon bya mtshon byed so sor sbyor tshul ji ltar byed lags/ zhes pa'i dri ba zhus pa'i tshul ston pa la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i rdzas/ /mtshon byed so sor ji ltar sbyor/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ rig pa'i dbang lnga sogs te/ de yang ma rig pa nyon mongs pa lnga rig pa ye shes lngar sgyur bar byed pa'i mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang / rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang / 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang / don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang / rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang dang lnga'i dbang rdzas chu/ cod paṇa/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming gzugs su grub pa med pas dngos su bshad pa med kyang / don gyis thob pa ming bzhi'i phung po mtshon byed rdor dril lhan cig pa dang lnga po de/ mtshon bya me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/

chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te lnga po de'i mtshon byed yin la/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan yang rtsa rgyu rgyud brtag pa gnyis las/ chu ni mi bskyod gzugs kyi phyir/ /zhe sdang 'dren pa mi bskyod pa/ /zhes sogs la brten nas 'chad pa lta bu mang du yod mod kyis/ re zhig mdor bsdus pa de tsam la gzhir byas nas rgyas par shes par gyis shig ces zhal 'phangs pa'i tshul gyi gdams pa dang bcas te dris lan gsal bar ston pa la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i rdzas/ /ye shes lnga yi mtshon byed yin/ /'di yi rgyu mtshan mang mod kyis/ /mdor bsdus de tsam shes par gyis/ /zhes pa 'di byung / /dri ba bcu bdun pa'i zhu tshig ni/ rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs te/ de yang yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa/ rnam par snang mdzad de rigs lnga zhes mang du gsungs pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs kyi sku gnyis kyi nang nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'am sprul pa'i sku gang du bzhed lags zhes dri ba zhu ba'i tshul ston pa la/ rgyal ba rigs lnga gsungs pa ni/ /longs sku'am sprul sku gang du bzhed/ /ces pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ ye shes lnga ni zhes sogs te/ de yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /dag las nye dang ring rnams la/ /'jig rten rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /chu dang nam mkhar zla gzugs bzhin/ /de mthong ba ni rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gdul bya las dag ma dag gi dbang gis snang tshul mtha' gcig tu nges pa med kyang / spyir btang gi dbang du byas na sprul pa'i skur bshad pa ni/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa ye shes lnga gzugs kyi sku'i rnam par bzhengs te/ gdul bya rigs can gsum gyi don mdzad par mtshon pa'i phyir na/ rgyal ba rigs lnga po de nyid mchog gi sprul skur gsungs pa yin te/

gdul bya mchog rigs can gsum la mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa de ltar du snang bas so/ /yang 'jam dbyangs bla ma sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams dang / /zhes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bshad pa ni gdul bya rigs can gsum gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'i byang sems 'phags pa rnams la gnang ba la dgongs pa yin te/ 'khor nges pa byang 'phags rnams la de ltar snang bas so/ /zhes pa'i dris lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ ye shes lnga ni mtshon pa'i phyir/ /rigs lnga mchog gi sprul pa ste/ /gdul bya mchog la de ltar snang / /longs skur bshad pa mchog la dgongs/ /zhes pa 'di byung / dri ba bco brgyad pa'i zhu tshig ni/ rigs lnga chos gos sogs te/ de yang rigs lnga mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i cha lugs can rnams de ltar lags na/ chos gos rnam gsum can dang dbu'i gtsug tor phyed pa can la sogs pa dge sbyong gi cha lugs can rnams longs sku'am sprul sku gang du bzhed lags zhes dri ba zhu ba'i tshul ston pa la/ rigs lnga chos gos gtsug tor can/ /longs sku'am sprul sku gang du bzhed/ /ces pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ rigs lnga dge sbyong sogs te/ de yang rgyal ba rigs lnga chos gos rnam gsum can gyi dge sbyong gi cha lugs su 'byung ba/ skyes bu dam pa'i gsung 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba ni thos la/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos sogs lung tshad ldan las bshad pa ni dris lan byed pa po ngas ma mthong mod/ 'on kyang yo ga de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas dang sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams ji ltar 'dul bar 'os pa'i gdul bya de'i blo dang 'tshams pa de dang der dga' ba'i sku dang cha lugs can du mdzad nas thar pa la 'god par byed ces gsungs pas na/ dge sbyong gi cha lugs dang tshul lugs can la sogs pa gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pas 'gal ba ci yang med la/

de ltar na dge sbyong gi cha lugs can gyi rigs lnga de dag sprul skur bzhed pa lags/ zhes pa'i dris lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ rigs lnga dge sbyong cha lugs su/ /dam pa'i gsung las byung ba thos/ /lung las bshad pa ngas ma mthong / /'on kyang de nyid 'dus pa las/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /ji ltar dga' ba'i sku dang ni/ /cha lugs can zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /dge sbyong tshul la'ang 'gal ba med/ /ces pa 'di byung / 'ang zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas sku gcig tu ma nges par sna tshogs su ston par 'don pa yin te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad thog mar dbyings rig dbyer med kyi chos sku mngon du mdzad/ de'i ngang nas gdul bya mchog sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan/ gdul bya 'bring rigs can gsum la mchog gi sprul skur bstan/ gdul bya tha mal pa 'dul ba'i zhing du gyur pa rnams la rgyal po dang / blon po dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / lha dang / klu dang / ri bong dang / stag dang / gzig dang / seng ge dang / gzhan yang gzings dang / zam pa dang / der ma zad nyer mkho'i dngos po rnam pa sna tshogs gang la gang 'dod du bstan nas sems can gyi don dpag tu med/ gzhal du med/ bgrang ba las 'das pa 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi chad par mdzad pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad pa 'phrin las zhes bya ba de'i chos nyid lags pas so/ /de rnams kyis dri ba bco brgyad pa dris lan zhar byung dang bcas pa song nas/ ༈ /dri ba bcu dgu pa'i zhu tshig ni/ dam pa rigs brgya'i dbye ba 'di/ /mdor bsdus dbye lugs sogs te/ de yang rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ de rnams rigs ni rigs la rnam pa brgya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rigs dam pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha rgyal ba mi bskyod pa lta bu gcig nyid la nang gses kyi dbye ba rigs brgya'i dbye ba 'di mdor bsdus te dbye na dbye lugs sam bgrang lugs gang zhig gi sgo nas byed pa lags/

ces dri ba zhu ba'i tshul ston pa la/ dam pa rigs brgya'i dbye ba 'di/ /mdor bsdus dbye lugs gang gis byed/ /ces pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga zhes sogs te/ de yang spyir dges rdor/ zla gsang thig le/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ rnying ma ba'i lugs kyi gsang rnying du grags pa sogs dam pa rigs brgya'i rnam gzhag gsung tshul mang du yod kyang / 'dir kyai rdor nas gsungs pa dang gtso cher sbyar na gzhi lam 'bras gsum/ de'i nang nas 'bras bu la sbyar ba la yang sku dang ye shes la sbyar ba ni/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i rigs mi bskyod pa/ 'khor lo'i rigs rnam snang / rin po che'i rigs rin 'byung / pad+ma'i rigs 'od dpag med/ las kyi rigs don yod grub pa ste rigs lnga po re re la yang me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te ye shes lnga lnga dang ldan pas na/ rigs lnga re re yang ye shes lnga lnga'i bdag nyid can te/ rgyal ba mi bskyod pa'i thugs rgyud kyi ye shes lnga la sogs pa lnga tshan lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga/ ye shes nyi shu rtsa lnga po re res kyang gzhan don 'phrin las kyi bdag rkyen byed tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ re re la yang byams pa tshad med/ snying rje tshad med/ dga' ba tshad med/ btang snyoms tshad med de tshad med bzhi bzhi phye ba de'i phyir nyer lnga pa tshan pa bzhi po de dag la ye shes kyi dbang du byas pa'i rigs rnam pa brgya/ de bzhin du sku la sbyar na rgyal ba rigs lnga re re la ye shes lnga gzugs rnams su bzhengs pa'i mi bskyod pa'i mi bskyod pa la sogs pa lnga tshan lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga/ nyi shu rtsa lnga re re la yang thugs rgyud kyi byams sogs tshad med bzhi gzugs rnams su bzhengs pa'i lha mo puk+ka sī/ ri khrod ma/

gdol pa mo/ g.yung mo ste bzhi po de bzhi bzhir phye bas nyer lnga po mtshon pa bzhi po de dag 'bras bu sku'i dbang du byas pa'i dam pa rigs brgyar 'jog pa yin/ zhes ston pa la/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga re re yang / /ye shes lnga lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /ye shes re 'ang gzhan don gyis/ /dbye na tshad med bzhi bzhi 'o/ /de phyir de dag rigs rnams brgya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / bshad ma thag pa 'di dag ni 'bras bu'i dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang du byas pa'i dbye ba ste/ yang de nyid rgyu'i rigs brgya la rigs pas dpyad de sbyar na/ sbyang gzhi 'byung ba sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang lnga po re re la/ sbyang bya nyon mongs pa/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti mug nga rgyal/ phrag dog ste lnga lnga gnas pas nyer lnga/ de dag re re la yang nang gses kyis phye na sha chen spyi khyab tu btang ba'i byang sems dkar dmar gnyis/ dri chen dri chu gnyis te bdud rtsi bzhi bzhi ste brgya/ lam la sbyar na yang sbyong byed kyi rigs lnga po re re la/ mngon byang ye shes lnga lngar phye bas nyer lnga/ de re re la 'khor yum bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa'i dam pa rigs brgyar shes par bya'o/ /zhes ston pa la/ 'di ni 'bras bu'i dbye ba ste/ /rgyu dang lam yang 'dis dpyad bya/ /zhes pa 'di byung / yang gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i bzhed srol gyi dbang du byas na/ zhi ba'i tshul dgu dang ldan pa'i zhi ba'i lha ni kun tu bzang po dang mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i rgyal ba rigs drug kun tu bzang mo dang sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma yum drug ste bcu gnyis/ byams pa la sogs te nye ba'i sras te yab brgyad/ sgeg mo sogs nang gi bzhi dang / bdug spos ma sogs phyi'i bzhi ste yum brgyad dang bcas pas bcu drug stobs po che/ gshin rje gshed/ rta mgrin/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ste yab bzhi/ lcags kyu ma sogs te yum bzhi ste sgo ba yab yum brgyad/

lha'i thub pa dang / mi'i thub pa la sogs pa thub pa drug ste 'di dag la zhi ba'i lha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'i khro bo'i lha ni yab badz+ra he ru ka dang / yum badz+ra kro dhi shwa ri ste rdo rje khrag 'thung yab yum sogs/ khrag 'thung he ru ka yab yum bcu/ srin po dā sha gṛ ba'i chung ma srin mo chen po mi srin mo la sogs pa dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ gā+au rī ma dang / tsau rī ma la sogs pa'i gnas ma brgyad/ seng gdong ma chen po dang / stag gdong ma chen mo la sogs pa'i yul ma brgyad/ sring 'gro stag gdong ma/ rdo rje phag gdong ma/ 'jig rten dred gdong ma/ ro langs spyang gdong ma ste sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pas khro bo pho mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad po de dag la dam pa rigs brgyar 'jog pa yin no zhes gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i rgyud gsang rnying du grags pa la rten gzhir byas te/ rje sgro phug pa la sogs pa rnying ma ba rnams smra bar byed mod kyi/ 'on kyang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas bsgyur ba las byung ba'i rgyud sde tshad ldan rnams las dam pa rigs brgya de lta bu ma grags pas rang lugs 'thad ldan du 'dzin par dka' la/ de ltar na'ang bdag chen rgya dkar ba la sogs pa'i rang lugs kyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gsung las/ zhe gnyis zhi ba'i lha tshogs dang / /lnga bcu rtsa brgyad khro bo'i tshogs/ /zhes lha brgyar gsungs pa dang / rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi/ /zhes pa dang / dregs pa dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad ma/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rnams la brten nas lha ngos 'dzin tshul dang grangs 'dren tshul dgos pa rnams ni/ 'o skol gyi 'dren mchog dam pa sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i gter chen gyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i stod las byang chub sgrub pa dang / smad las dgra bgegs drag po sgrol ba'i rnam bshad chen mo rnam pa gnyis kyi steng nas/

gus ldan rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i blo gsal rnams kyis rtogs par mdzod cig ces zhar byung dang bcas pa'i sgo nas zhus lan gsal bar ston pa la/ zhi ba'i lha ni bzhi bcu gnyis/ /khro bo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la/ /dam pa rigs brgya yin no zhes/ /rnying ma ba rnams smra mod kyi/ /'phags pa'i yul las byung ba yi/ /rgyud sde rnams las de ma grags/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba nyi shu pa'i zhu tshig ni/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul sogs te/ rgyal ba yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par sprul pa gcig nyid gdul bya 'dul ba'i don du sku sna tshogs su sprul par mtshungs pa la/ sprul pa'i lha rnams la brten nas dngos grub 'grub thag nye ring du 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags/ zhes dri ba zhu ba'i tshul de ston pa la/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul gcig nyid la/ /lha rnams dngos grub nye ring ci/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan ston par byed pa ni/ rgyal ba'i rnam sprul sogs te/ rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul gcig nyid sgrub par byed pa'i byed las/ gdan gsum dngos su tshang ba'i rnam pa dngos su bsgom pa dang ma bsgom pa las 'bras bu 'grub thag nye ring dang / sgrub pa po rang gi ming yig dang po dang gang du gnas pa'i gnas gang gi ming yig dang po dang / gang sgrub pa'i yi dam re'i mtshan yig dang po dang / gang bzla ba'i sngags kyi yi ge dang po rnams byung ba dgra grogs mthun mi mthun pa'i brten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba las 'bras bu 'grub thag nye ring dang / yang sgrub pa po rang skal gyi las kyi lha la me tog phog pa'i lha dang ma phog pa'i lha bsgrub pa'i khyad par las dngos grub 'grub pa nye ring gi khyad par 'byung bar gsungs shing / de yang ma zad lha rang ngos nas thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi mthus zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs thun mong gi las bsgrub pa'i lha la rje btsun ma sgrol ma dngos grub myur ba dang /

thun mong ma yin pa phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa la/ pho nya rnam gsum bsre ba sogs thabs mkhas kyi mthus bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog nyid shin tu nas sgrub thag nye'o zhes dris lan byed pa po bdag gi bla ma rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa gang de'i gsung las 'byung ba lags/ zhes zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul gcig nyid las/ /rnam pa rten cing 'brel 'byung dang / /sgrub pa'i las kyi dngos grub las/ /nye ring 'byung zhing de'ang ni/ /thun mong lha la sgrol ma dang / /thun mong min la bde ba'i mchog /shin tu sgrub thag nye'o zhes/ /bla ma mchog gi gsung las 'byung / /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba nyer gcig pa'i zhu tshig ni/ sgrol ma lta bu'i sogs te/ de yang rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du rje btsun ma sgrol ma lta bu'i lha bsgom pa dang / gsang sngags bzlas pa'i sgo nas rje btsun ma de nyin bsgrub pa dang / bcom 'das 'khor lo bde mchog dang dges pa rdo rje lta bu'i lha bsgom pa dang / gsang sngags bzlas pa'i sgo nas lha de nyid bsgrubs pa las/ thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub pa dang / mchog gi dngos grub 'grub pa'i khyad par 'di tsam 'byung ba gang lags/ zhes dri ba zhus pa'i tshul ston pa la/ sgrol ma lta bu'i bsgom bzlas dang / /bde dgyes dngos grub khyad par ci/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan ston par byed pa ni/ sgrol ma la sogs te/ de yang spyir gzhi dam tshig dang sdom pa la legs par gnas shing / man ngag zab mo nyid drag la rgyun mi chad pa'i brtson 'grus kyi sgo nas sgrol ma/ rnam rgyal/ bde kye gsang gsum sogs yi dam khyad par can gang sgrub na'ang / dngos grub rnam gnyis gang 'dod 'grub pa gzhir bcas lags mod/ 'od kyang rgyud sde so so las gsungs tshul gtso che ba'i dbang du btang na/

yi dam lha tshogs rnams la las rgyas pa'i lha dang mchog bsgrub pa'i lha gnyis su dbye bar mdzad nas/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par rgyal ma don la sangs rgyas yin kyang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bzung la nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la sogs pa rnams las rgyas pa'i lha zhes bya ba thun mong gi dngos grub zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs sgrub pa'i lha ru gsungs la/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje/ 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje gzhon nu/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rnams la mchog sgrub pa'i lha zhes bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob byed kyi lha yin par gsungs pas so/ /zhes zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ sgrol ma la sogs thun mong gi /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i lha ru gsungs/ /dgyes rdor bde mchog la sogs pa/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob byed yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba nyer gnyis pa'i zhu tshig ni/ phyag mtshan brgyad sogs te/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i phyag bcu drug gi thod nang na gnas pa skye 'gro'i gzugs can rnams bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis mtshon byed du sbyar nas gsungs shing / de'i nang tshan g.yon pa'i phyag mtshan sa'i lha la sogs pa brgyad kyis dbang phyug brgyad mtshon par gsungs lags na/ 'dir skabs kyi dbang phyug de brgyad po ngos 'dzin tshul ji ltar lags/ zhes dri ba zhu pa'i tshul ston pa la/ phyag mtshan brgyad kyi dbang phyug brgyad/ /de brgyad ngos 'dzin ji ltar lags/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ dbang phyug brgyad ni/ zhes sogs te/ de yang dbang phyug brgyad ngos 'dzin tshul la/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i zhabs kyis/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dbang phyug dang / /zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dbang phyug lnga/ rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang phyug

kun 'phro'i dbang phyug ci 'dod bskyed pa'i dbang phyug ste dbang phyug brgyad kyi rnam gzhag kyai rdo rje ba'i tshul dang mi mthun pa'i gzhan bshad pa yod mod kyi/ skabs 'dir phyag mtshan brgyad kyi dag par bshad pa'i dbang phyug brgyad ngos 'dzin tshul ni/ rgya gar gyi paṇa chen sbyangs dka' zla ba'am mi thub zla bar grags pa de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ sa ni dang por nor 'dzin mtha'/ /dbang phyug brgyad ni stsol bar mdzad/ /ces gsungs la/ de'i don ni rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ sa dang chu dang rlung dang ni/ /me dang zla ba nyi ma dang / /thar byed dang ni nor sbyin nyid/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i go rim la so so skye bo bla ma'i man ngag la ma brten par rgyud don la rang dgar 'jug pa spang ba'i phyir/ man ngag gi 'khrugs sdeb pa dang sbyar na/ sa'i lha ser po ni phyag g.yon gyi dang pos 'dzin la/ des 'byung ba sa la dbang bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug mtshon/ de bzhin du gnyis pas 'dzin pa chu'i lha dkar pos chu la dbang bsgyur/ gsum pas 'dzin pa me'i lha dmar pos me la dbang bsgyur/ bzhi pas 'dzin pa rlung gi lha ljang khus rlung la dbang bsgyur ba ste 'byung ba bzhi la dbang bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug bzhi dang / yang phyag lnga pas 'dzin pa zla ba'i lha dkar pos zla ba la dbang bsgyur/ drug pas 'dzin pa nyi ma'i lha dmar pos nyi ma la dbang bsgyur/ bdun pas 'dzin pa gshin rje mthar byed kyis tshe la dbang bsgyur/ phyag mtha' ma brgyad pas 'dzin pa nor 'dzin nam nor sbyin nam/ don la nor lha ser pos nor la dbang bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug dang brgyad ni skabs su bab pa 'dir bstan gyi dbang phyug brgyad ngos 'dzin tshul yin zhes zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ dbang phyug brgyad ni zla grags kyis/ /rnam gzhag gzhan du bshad mod kyis/ /phyag mtshan brgyad kyi dag pa ni/ /mi thub zla ba'i zhal snga nas/

/sa ni dang po nor 'dzin mtha'/ /zhes gsungs don ni 'byung bzhi dang / nyi zla tshe dang nor rnams la/ /dbang bsgyur brgyad ni dbang phyug brgyad/ /ces pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba nyer gsum pa'i zhu tshig ni/ bdag gnas rnal 'byor khyad par gang / /zhes pa ste/ de la 'dus pa rnam gnyis la sogs pa'i rgyud sde rnams las srung 'khor gyi skabs su/ bdag srung ba/ gnas srung ba/ rnal 'byor srung ba zhes gsungs pa'i bdag gnas rnal 'byor gsum po'i khyad par gang gi sgo nas 'byed pa lags/ zhes dri ba zhus pa'i tshul ston pa la/ bdag gnas rnal 'byor khyad par gang / /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ bdag gnas rnal 'byor sogs te/ de yang bdag bsrung / gnas bsrung / rnal 'byor bsrung ba zhes gsum gsungs pa'i nang tshan/ bdag ces pa'i bdag ni spyir rgyud las/ bdag dang gso ba sems can dang / /zhes byed pa'i skyes bu bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan la 'jog pa yod kyang / 'dir ni skabs thob rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa po nyid la ngos 'dzin pa yin la/ de srung byed kyi nyams len ni/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs dang sbyar te bshad kyang rung mod/ 'on kyang grags che bas go sla ba'i phyir kun rig gi sgrub dkyil gzhan phan mtha' yas dang sbyar na/ de yang sbyong rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug ste/ /thams cad bzos te kun byas kyang / /'grub 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar rdo rje sems dpar wal gyis bskyed de/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya hūm̐ zhes brjod cing rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas rdul tshon nam ras bris gang yin gyi dkyil 'khor de'i shar phyogs kyi sgo nang du 'khod par mos la/ de nas mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ ye shes tshogs bsag rdo rje sems dpar gsal btab pa'i lce dang lag pa byin rlabs byas rjes/

rgyud las/ bdag bsrungs la sogs byas nas ni/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ bdag bsrung dngos ni/ bdag nyid khro bo me 'bar ba zhes sogs kyis khro bo dngos lta bur gsal btab ste de'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang / spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lnga'i ngo bo rigs lngar ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa rtse phran lnga sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum dang bcas pas bsgom pa la dar dkar po'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsam pa de nyid yin zhing / gnas bsrungs pa la skabs 'di'i gnas ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa po nyid gang du sgrub pa byed pa'i yul phyogs de yin pas/ de srung byed kyi nyams len la/ sngar yod kyi bgegs tshar gcad pa'i phyir oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la sogs sngags gsum phyag rgya gsum/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang bcas pas bsnun bsreg bcing gsum bya/ phyin chad bgegs kyis mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra ḍi ḍo me bha wa sogs kyis 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyogs rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad hūm̐ mdzad kyi ra gur sogs kyis go mtshams med par gtams pa nyid brtan byed yi ge brgya pas brtan par byed pa'i skabs yin la/ rnal 'byor bsrung ba zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ni gzhung lugs kun mthun pa ltar ting nge 'dzin du 'dod pa yin zhing / ting nge 'dzin de nyid dngos gzhi'i skabs su gsal bar skye ba'i gegs thams cad bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ srung 'khor gyi skabs 'dir dmigs pa gsal zhing yid rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas ma yengs par bsgom pa la rnal 'byor bsrung ba zhes bya bar gsungs pa yin zhes zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ bdag gnas rnal 'byor gsum gsungs pa/ /bdag ni sgrub po nyid yin te/ /rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin du 'dod/ /ting 'dzin skye ba'i gegs bsal phyir/ /rnal 'byor srung bar gsungs pa yin/

/gnas ni gang du bsgrub pa'i yul/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba nyer bzhi pa'i zhu tshig ni/ bskyed rim dmigs pa sogs te/ de yang gsang sngags bla med kyi zab lam khyad par can bskyed rim lhar bsgom pa'i tshe lha'i dmigs pa mi gsal na/ de gsal bar bya ba'i thabs dang tshul lugs gang dang gang gi sgo nas spyad na gsal bar 'gyur ba mchis lags/ ces dri ba zhu ba'i tshul ston pa la/ bskyed rim dmigs pa mi gsal na/ /thabs tshul gang gis gsal bar mchis/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ lha'i dmigs pa zhes sogs te/ de yang snod bcud thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang du bsgom pa'i tshe/ lha'i dmigs pa gsal bar byed pa'i thabs la/ thog mar rang sems ma yengs pa gal che ste/ sems nang du gzhol ba dang bral ba'i dbang gis phyi rol gyi yul la dmigs nas mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs pas rnam par g.yeng ba rnams la/ rang gi sems ni las su rung ba thob par dka' ba yin/ sems las su ma rung bas ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par mi nus/ des na sems las su rung ba'i don du dmigs pa gcig nyid la sems legs par gtod la ma yengs par gyis dang / des ni re zhig na yid rnal du gnas pas rnam rtog gi 'du 'phro rags pa nye bar zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig pa thob par 'gyur/ don 'di la dgongs nas 'jam dbyangs bla ma sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ phyi rol mtshan mas g.yengs rnams la/ /sems ni las rung thob dka' bas/ /dmigs pa nyid la sems gtod dang / /yid ni zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin/ de yang dmigs rten gang yang rung ba la brten nas sems zin par sla zhing / de la gsang sngags kyi man ngag khyad par can rnams las/ yi dam gyi lha'i spyan dang shangs la sogs pa sku'i cha shas re re la dmigs pa goms par byas nas bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa gsal ba'i thabs la slob pa dang /

de nyid dmigs bsal lha'i spyan ri mor bris pa la sogs pa me long gi ngos la shar ba'i gzugs brnyan la dmigs te de dang 'dra bar lha'i spyan la sogs bsgoms pas snang la rang bzhin med pa'i lha'i dmigs pa nyid rim pa je gsal je gsal gyi sgo nas gsal bar 'gyur bar gsungs/ mdo sde la sogs pa las rnam rtog gi gnyen por dbugs dbyung rngub bsgom pa zhes bya ba nang dbugs 'byung 'jug gi khug pa brgya'i bar du bgrang ba las sems 'dzin pa dang / nges don la 'ga' zhig rnam rtog gang ltar gyi ngo bo la sems 'dzin pa dang / mkhas pas gsung rab kyi don la rang byan tshud pa dag yid la gang 'bab pa'i mdo rgyud kyi tshig don la sems 'dzin pa sogs tha snyad mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod kyang / don sems gnas pa'i thabs su gcig pa kho na yin pas de dag dang / rgyas par gzhan mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sku lus kyi/ /'jig rten mgon po kun nas mdzes pa ste/ /dmigs pa de la gang gis sems 'jog pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de mnyam bzhag ces bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams su len tshul bsgom rim tha ma las bshad pa ltar shes par gyis la dang por dmigs rten la brten nas sems zin/ de nyid bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin dang sbyar/ de nyid gang bskyed pa'i lha dang sbyar la lha'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya dgos/ zhes zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ lha'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i thabs/ /spyan sogs sku'i cha shas la/ /goms par byas nas slob pa dang / /bris pa la sogs me long la/ /shar ba'i gzugs brnyan la dmigs te/ /de dang 'dra bar bsgom pa yis/ /rim gyis dmigs pa gsal bar 'gyur/ /rgyas par gzhan las shes par gyis/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba nyer lnga pa'i zhu tshig ni/ dben par skyo ba sogs te/ de yang grong dang 'du 'dzis dben pa'i sar rang gcig pu gnas pa'i tshe sems la skyo ba skyes par gyur na/

sems skyo ba de bsal ba'i thabs dang tshul dang lugs ji ltar spyad par bgyi lags/ zhes dri ba zhu ba'i tshul ston pa la/ dben par skyo ba skyes pa na/ /tshul lugs ji ltar dpyad par bgyi/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ snying rje bde ba sogs te/ de yang sems kyi ngo bo la bltas pas gang du yang ma grub pa'i bden med spros bral du gsungs pa la/ skyo bar snang ba 'di ngo bo spros bral du ngo ma shes pas lan pa yin/ des na yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis chos rnams kyi ngo ba'am gnas lugs la dpyad na bden med spros bral du mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa la nges shes bskyed de/ rang gis kyang bden med spros bral du gtan la phab/ bden med de ma rtogs pa'i sems can kun la yang snying rje drag po bsgoms pas sems skyo bar snang ba'i sems tshor sdug bsngal de sel nus te/ bstan pa'i sgron me sa skya paṇa chen gyi zhal snga nas/ khyod la bden par gang rtog pa/ /de las sdug bsngal bden pa 'byung / /sems khyod brdzun par gang gis shes/ /de la sdug bsngal brdzun du zad/ /ces gsungs pa yin la/ yang na rje btsun rin po ches/ ji ltar byas kyang ma bde na/ /'khor ba'i mtshan nyid yid la gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid dam 'khor ba'i gnas lugs sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das/ de'i nang nas kyang ngan song gsum na spyir sdug bsngal gsum char dang / khyad par sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyis yun ring po'i bar du mnar bas na/ bde ba'i go skabs skad cig ma gcig tsam yang med par gsungs la/ de dag las spangs na rang re mi rnams la gnas skabs zag bcas kyi bde ba zhes bya ba'i sdug bsngal ngal gso lta bu'i bde ba dang ldan pa dang / khyad par rang nyid thob par dka' ba'i lus rten 'di la nad dang zug rngu la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe med cing khams bde la/

sems 'di la dgra 'dre la sogs pa'i brtsad pa yang med/ sdod pa'i gnas dang chos mthun gyi 'byor pa'i cha rkyen yang cung zad 'dzoms/ rang nyid kyis byung na lus rten 'di la sangs rgyas thob nges kyi man ngag zab mo nyams su blang chog pa 'di las dga' ba ci yod snyam du bde ba bsgom pas skyo ba sel nus te/ skyes bu dam pa'i gsungs las/ lus 'di la na tsha med khams su yang bde/ /sems 'di la gzhan dag gi rtsod pa yang med/ /gnas 'di dang cha rkyen yang cung zad 'dzoms/ /dus da lta chos la 'bad par rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin cing / gzhan yang kha na ma tho ba'i zas gsad sha dang / sgog tsong dang / btung ba myos 'gyur sogs spangs te/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs lha'i bdud rtsi lta bu'i ro mchog dang ldan pa lce'i dbang pos myong ba sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la chags med zhen med du longs spyad pas kyang yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi myang ba zhes bya ba/ tshor ba sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba sel ba'i thabs su gsungs shing / gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi mkhyen pa phyogs med du rgyas shing / lhag bsam rnam dag dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'bel gtam lhug par byas pas kyang yid mi bde ba'i skyo ba sel nus la/ der ma zad rje btsun rin po ches/ sdig pa las log pa'i chos pa kun/ /mdo rgyud la lta rtog bag re mdzod/ /ces sdig pa mi dge ba las ldog ste dge ba bya 'dod pa'i chos pa kun/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel ba'i thabs su legs par gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud zab mo rnams dang / de dag gi dgongs 'grel rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par mdzad pa'i bstan bcos tshad ldan sogs la bltas shing rtog dpyod bag re byas pas yid mi bde ba la sogs pa'i skyo ba dang sdug bsngal thams cad sel nus par gsungs pas na/

de ltar sel ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya ste/ sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad ni/ /sgrib kun sel byed dam pa'i chos/ /zhes pa dang / spyod 'jug las/ mdo sde rnams las bslab pa snang / de bas mdo sde bklag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gzhan yang sems skyo ba skyes pa'i tshe/ /de sel ba'i thabs ji ltar 'os pa rang nyid kyi rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyis rnam par dpyad nas kyang shes par bya ste/ de'i tshul yang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mdo sde lang kar gshegs pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes khams gsum snod bcud thams cad rang rang gi sems snang tsam du gsungs pa dang / rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don nam/ /phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med/ /ces sems snang las logs su gyur pa'i sangs rgyas dang sems can/ rnam par shes pa'i yul gyi phyi don dang bcas cung zad tsam yang med par gsungs pa dang / slob dpon sa ra has/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'gro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed/ /ces rang 'khor 'das gang 'dod kyi 'bras bu ster ba'i sa bon sems nyid kho nar gsungs pa dang / slob dpon bir+wa pa pas/ chos kun sems nyid snang ba/ zhes chos thams cad sems kyi snang ba kho nar gsungs pa dang / mgon po byams pas/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas/ /de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs/ /zhes sems las gzhan du gyur pa'i chos med par ma zad/ btsal na sems nyid kyang med par gsungs pa dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ phan pa'i gdams ngag don po 'di lags te/ /khyod kyis sems dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis/ /sems ni chos kyi rtsa bar lags par gsungs/ /zhes chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems yin pas de dul dgos par gdams pa dang /

slob dpon thogs med kyis/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /mi rnams ji ltar rigs rigs su/ /dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes dngos po gcig nyid la 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems snang tshul tha dad tsam ma gtogs/ sems snang las gzhan pa'i phyi don sogs gang yang med par gsungs pa dang / dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ chu 'bab klung la yi dwags rnag blo yang / /mdor na ji ltar shes bya med de bzhin/ /blo yang med ces don 'di shes par gyis/ /zhes sngar gyi de nyid mtshan gzhir bgar te/ yul yul can thams cad bden med du gdams pa dang / gzhan yang rje sa skya pa chen pos/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni rdo rje yin la/ sngags pa ci dad ci byed pa thams cad snang ba de dag gi ngo bor snang la/ rang gi ngo bo'i go yul du sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gcig gi rnam par 'phrul pa yin par shes nas nyams su len pas na rdo rje theg pa'o/ /zhes spyir snang thams cad sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gsungs pa dang / rje btsun rin po ches/ chos kun sems kyi spyod yul yin/ /phya dang dbang phyug la sogs pa/ /'byung bzhi'i byed mkhan ma 'tshol bar/ /sems nyid kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog /ces pa dang / sangs rgyas gtan la 'bebs tsam na/ /sems las ma gtogs chos rnams med/ /sems nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas yin/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas btsal du med/ /ces chos thams cad sems kyi snang tshul tsam ma gtogs de las gzhan rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' ngan pas rtag pa bden grub sogs gang yang yod pa ma yin zhing sangs rgyas zhes bya ba yang rang gi sems nyid bden med spros bral du rtogs pa mthar thug pa las gzhan du med par gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du chos rje sa skya paṇa chen sogs rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rigs dri med du byon pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams dang /

de dag gi chos srid legs par 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub dam pa rje ngor pa yab sras la sogs pa rnams kyis lta ba gtan 'bebs dang sbyar te mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig nyid du gsung don hril gyis dril na 'khor 'das bya byed thams cad rang sems gsal stong zug 'jug gi rol pa las ma 'das pas na/ yid skyo bar snang ba'am yid sdug bsngal bar snang ba yang / yid bde ba'am yon tan gyi rang bzhin du shes par byas nas skyo ba bsal bar bya ste/ sdug bsngal med par nges 'byung med/ /ces 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du rtogs pa med par nges 'byung lhag med myang 'das thob pa med par gsungs pas sdug bsngal bar mthong ba yon tan gyi rang bzhin yin la/ der ma zad yid skyo ba lta bu sdug bsngal myong ba las byung ba'i yon tan gyi khyad par ni/ sdug bsngal gyis yid 'byung skye zhing skyo ba la brten nas nga rgyal gyis khengs pa'i dregs pa rnams sel bar byed pa'i yon tan dang / rang gi yid skyo ba lta bu sdug bsngal cung zad myong ba la dpag nas/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pa rnams la snying rje tshad med pa skye ba'i yon tan dang / yid skyo bar snang ba 'di ni rang gi las ngan sdig pa bsags pa'i 'bras bu'o snyam du shes par byas nas/ de phyin chad rgyu sdig pa la 'dzem zhing dge ba la dga' ba'i yon tan dang / der ma zad sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i lam ston pa po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la yid ches shing dad pa'i yon tan yang skye bar 'gyur bas na/ yid skyo bar snang ba yon tan gyi ngang tshul can te/ de skad du yang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas spyod 'jug tu/ gzhan yang sdug bsngal yon tan ni/ /skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed/ /'khor ba pa la snying rje skyes/ /sdig la 'dzem zhing dge la dga'/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /zhes sngar gyi zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/

snying rje bde ba bsgom pa dang / /kha na ma tho med pa yi/ /'dod pa'i yon tan spyod pa dang / /chos kyi gtam dang mdo sogs la/ /bltas pas skyo ba bsal bar bya/ /ji ltar 'os pa rang gis spyad/ /ces pa 'di byung / dri ba nyer drug pa'i zhu tshig ni/ nad dang zug rngus sogs te/ de yang rang lus 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po 'di la/ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa la sogs pa'i nad dang / de la brten pa'i zug rngus nyen te lus sems mi bde ba lus tshor sdug bsngal dang / sems tshor yid mi bde ba'i stobs kyis mi bde ba byung srid na/ de'i gnyen por 'gro ba'i nyams len khyad par can ji ltar yin lags zhes dri ba zhus tshul ston pa la/ nad dang zug rngus nyen pa na/ /gnyen po nyams len ji ltar yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ nad dang zug rngu glo bur gyi/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang spyir 'di lta bu'i gnyen po la/ phyogs re mgo gnon gyi gnyen po dang / mtha' dag dpyis 'byin gyi gnyen po gnyis su yod pa las/ 'dir rang re theg pa chen po'i nyams len tshul bzhin du skyong ba rnams la/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis mkhris pa la sogs pa'i nad dang / de la brten pa'i zug rngu ste zug gzer lta bu mi 'byung mod/ 'on kyang mdo sde las brgya pa las/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za bar gnas dang dus/ /tshogs shing dus la babs pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / spyod 'jug las/ nyes pa ji snyed thams cad dang / /sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /de kun rkyen kyi stobs las byung / /rang dbang yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rkyen glo bur ba'i stobs kyis 'byung srid na/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ mkhas pas sdug bsngal byung yang ni/ /sems kyis rab dang rnyog mi bya/ /zhes gnod pa bzod pa la mkhas pas nad la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal drag po byung yang /

sems kyi rab tu dga' ba'i stobs kyis yid mi bde bas rnyog par mi bya bar gsungs pa ltar sngon gyis las ngan bsags pa zad pa dang / 'phral rkyen glo bur ba tsam yin pas 'di tsam la bzod pa lhur blangs nas/ nyon mongs pa nad kyi rnam par snang ba 'di rnams kyi gnyen po dngos gzhi bla na med pa ni mtha' dag dpyis 'byin pa'i gnyen po zhes bya ba/ rgyu bdag 'dzin thams cad rtsa ba nas drung 'byin par byed pa'i thabs chos thams cad bden pas stong ba'i blo/ stong nyid bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa mchog yin te/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ bdag med bdag dang 'gal bas na/ /bdag med mthong bas de sun 'byin/ /zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin du lhag bsam bstan pa'i mdo la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las/ stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi/ /sgom pa lhag ma de don yin/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so/ /zhes zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ nad dang zug rngu glo bur gyi/ /nyon mongs rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /stong nyid ting 'dzin mchog yin zhes/ /lhag bsam bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba nyer bdun pa'i zhu tshig ni/ 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas gtugs pa na/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang sdug bsngal rgya mtshor drin can pha ma rnams/ /las kyi chu bo chen pos khyer mthong nas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las kyi chu bo chen po skye rga na 'chi bzhi'i nang nas/ 'chi ba'i chu bo chen pos khyer te 'jigs pa'i dus la babs te gtugs pa'i tshe na/ 'jigs pa de'i gnyen po dam pa'i chos kyi snying po nyams len ji lta bu zhig nyams su blangs na bde bar 'gyur ba yin zhing thabs dang tshul lugs ji lta bu zhig gam gang gis byas na bde bar 'gyur ba yin lags/ zhes pa'i dri ba zhus tshul ston pa la/ 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas gtugs pa na/ /nyams len tshul lugs gang gis bde/

/zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ rang lus lha yi grong khyer sogs te/ de yang gnas skabs de dag gi tshe skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum mngon sum bzhin du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam la/ dug gsum la sogs pa gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad spangs te 'da' ka ma'i gdams ngag 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la sgrim dgos te/ de la 'pho ba'i tshul la/ nyal 'pho dang / tha mal gyi ngang nas 'pho ba dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi ngang nas 'pho ba dang / de la yang nang gses kyi dbye ba bum dbang la sogs pa dbang bzhi'i 'pho ba dang bzhi/ der ma zad man ngag zab mo rnams nas 'pho ba'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs/ da lan 'dir bskyed rim kyi ngang nas 'pho ba'i tshul dang sbyar na/ 'di la yang goms pa sngon du 'gro ba gnad du che bas/ rgyun du goms par byed pa'i nyams len dang / nying mtshams sbyor ba'i dus kyi nyams len gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i lha'i snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i lha'i pho brang ngam grong khyer nas sems nyid hūm̐ du gsal ba de/ rang nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po'i zab mo sku lus kyi bde chen 'khor lo'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong pa de'i dbus sam snying por chu skyes te pad+ma'i gdan steng du gsal bar bzhugs pa'i mi bskyod rdo rje'i thugs kar rang sems bar snang du glog 'khyug pa'i tshul gyis rab tu 'jug cing / de nyid skar mda'i tshul gyis bla ma'i thugs kar thims pas/ bla ma'i thugs chos kyi dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig tu 'dres pa ji bzhin du rang gi sems kyang dbyings rig dbyer med du gyur pa/ bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems gnyis med spros bral rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la ci nus su mnyam par 'jog cing / slar hūm̐ de nyid rang gi snying khar thims pa 'di nyid dus dang rnam pa kun tu bsgom par bya ba yin la/

gnyis pa la ni/ de ltar goms par byas pa de nyid phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe/ rang sems hūm̐ du gsal ba bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med ro gcig tu bsres te bzhag go /'di lta bu'i nyams len khyad par can shes nas nyams su len pa'i gang zag la 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang / gshin rje'i pho nya la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad gyi na ste brdzun pa kho na yin pas/ nyams len zab mo 'di lta bu la 'bad par rigs so/ /zhes pa'i zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ rang lus lha yi grong khyer nas/ /bla ma rigs kyi bdag po yi/ /sku yi gzhal med yid 'ong bar/ /snying ka chu skyes gdan steng du/ /glog gi tshul du rab 'jug cing / /dbyings las ye shes ji bzhin du/ /skar mda'i tshul gyis 'dres gyur nas/ /mi rtog pa la mnyam gzhag pa/ /dus rnams kun tu bsgom par bya/ /goms nas nying mtshams sbyor tshe tsam/ /'di shes pa la 'chi ba dang / /gshin rje'i 'jigs pa gyi na yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba nyer brgyad pa'i zhu tshig ni/ theg pa dman la zhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas zhes sogs te/ de yang theg pa dman pa nyan thos kyi lam dang rang rgyal gyi lam du zhugs pa'i gang zag yin pa de/ gtan nas sangs rgyas thob pa'i gegs su 'gyur ram mi 'gyur ji ltar lags/ zhes dri ba zhus pa'i tshul ston pa la/ theg pa dman la zhugs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas gegs su gtan 'gyur ram/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ theg pa che las blo log nas/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang nyan thos sde gnyis kyi lugs ltar na/ mdo las/ dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyis/ /gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te/ /nyan thos dang ni rang sangs rgyas/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i gtan gyi gegs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mthar thug theg pa gsum du grub par bzhed pas theg pa dman pa'i dgra bcom pa gnyis rang rang gi byang chub kyis grol ba mthar thug thob par 'dod pa yod kyang /

'dir theg pa chen po dbu ma'i lugs ltar na/ skye bo thams cad bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mthar thug pa can yin te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs gtan nas mi rgya ba'i sems can ni gcig kyang med par bzhed la/ de la brten pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs pa'i gang zag la yang gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po nyid nas theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs pa'i theg chen tshogs lam pa gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob 'dod kyi theg pa chen po las blo log nas/ rang nyid gcig du zhi bde don gnyer gyi blos theg pa dman pa nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi theg pa gang rung kho nar zhugs par gyur na ji srid theg pa dman pa'i blo de las ma log na/ gnas skabs de srid du blo de'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas thob pa'i gegs su 'gyur la/ gnas skabs de tsam ma gtogs gtan nas sam mthar thug sangs rgya ba'i gegs su 'gyur ba ma yin te/ mthar thug theg pa dman pa'i nyan rang 'phags pa gnyis ka yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa nyid du 'gyur ro zhes dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po'i mdo sde la sogs pa nges pa'i don gyi brjod bya stong nyid ston pa'i sde rnams las gsungs pa'i phyir/ de skad du dam chos pad dkar las/ nga yang theg pa gcig las tsam ste sems can rnams la chos ston pa 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi theg pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar thug pa ste/ theg pa gnyis sam gsum zhes bya ba dag kyang med do/ /zhes sogs dang / yang de nyid las/ theg pa gcig ste gnyis la yod ma yin/ /gsum pa nam yang yod min 'jig rten na/ /skyes bu mchog rnams thabs kyi theg pa gang / /sna tshogs nye bar ston pa mdzad ma gtogs/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung las/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/

/zhes gsungs pas so/ /'o na theg dman so thar dang / theg dman gyi lam sogs la 'bad pa don med par 'gyur ro snyams na/ ma yin te/ de dag sangs rgyas byed kyi dngos kyi rgyu rkyen ma yin yang / theg dman so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la sogs pa rnams theg pa chen po'i lam gyi yan lag sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi nges 'byung gi bsam pas kun nas bslangs te nyams su len par byed na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa de'i grogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ nyams len phal cher ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ bsam pa bzang pos mchil lham gnyis/ /thub pa'i dbu la bzhag pa dang / /de ni gzhan gyis bsal byas pa/ /gnyis kas rgyal srid thob par gyur/ /de phyir bsam pa'i rtsa ba la/ /bsod nams sdig pa rnam par gnas/ /zhes pa dang / 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ des na da lta'i cho ga ni/ /bsam pa sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i/ /ces sogs dang / mdor na sems kyi 'phen pa las/ /gzhan pa'i dge sdig yod ma yin/ /zhes kun slong gi bsam pa gtso che ba'i dbang kho na yin par gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes zhus lan de gsal bar bstan pa la/ theg pa che la blo log nas/ /theg dman kho nar zhugs gyur na/ /ji srid de las ma log par/ /de srid de yi gegs su 'gyur/ /mthar thug 'phags pa gnyis ka yang / /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro zhes/ /dam chos pad+ma dkar la sogs/ /nges pa'i don gyi mdo las gsungs/ /so so thar pa'i sdom pa sogs/ /theg chen lam gyi yan lag tu/ /byed na de yi grogs su 'gyur/ /phal cher kun slong dbang yin no/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba nyer dgu pa'i zhu tshig ni/ dmigs med snying rje sogs dang / de yang snying rje chen po la dmigs pa'i sgo nas sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'i snying rje gsum du gsungs pa'i/

dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen po de skye ba'i dus tshod dang sa lam gang gi gnas skabs gang du skye bar 'gyur ba yin lags/ zhes dri ba zhu ba'i tshul ston pa la/ dmigs med snying rje chen po de/ /dus tshod gang du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/ dmigs med snying rje sogs te/ de yang dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ rang bzhin nyid kyis stong par mthong ba yi/ /'gro la snying rje gyur gang de la 'dud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dmigs yul rang bzhin gyis stong pas khyad par byas pa de/ rang bzhin gyis ma grub pas mi dmigs pa'am rang bzhin gyis grub par dmigs su med pa'i 'gro ba la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen po de la/ mtshan nyid pa dang / cha mthun pa dang / mthar thug pa dang gsum las/ de dag skye ba'i dus tshod mtshan nyid pa ni/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob pa la skye bar bshad cing / cha mthun pa ni da lta so so skye bo'i gnas skabs la'ang skye ba srid la mthar thug pa ni sa lam thams cad mthar phyin pa sangs rgyas kyi sa thob pa 'ba' zhig ste sangs rgyas kho na la skye ba yin/ zhes zhus lan de gsal bar ston pa la/ dmigs med snying rje mtshan nyid pa/ /rab dga'i sa la skye bar bshad/ /cha mthun da lta 'byung ba'ang srid/ /mthar phyin sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig la/ /zhes pa 'di byung / ༈ /dri ba sum cu pa'i zhu tshig ni/ rgyal ba'i sku gsum zhes sogs te/ de yang rgyal ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku gsum gyi rnam dag de gang dang gang rnam par dag pa yin tshul rgyas par mang du yod mod na'ang / mdor bsdus te snying po ngos 'dzin ji ltar bzhed pa yin lags/ zhes dri ba zhu ba'i tshul ston pa la/ rgyal ba'i sku gsum rnam dag te/ /mdor bsdus ji ltar bzhed pa lags/ /zhes pa 'di byung / de'i lan gsal bar ston pa ni/

chos sku rgyal ba'i sogs te/ de yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku ni/ spang bya las rgyal ba'i rgyal ba rnams kyi chos nyid rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa dang / chos can glo bur gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa ste dag pa gnyis ldan gyi rang bzhin can de/ mgon po byams pas/ thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa/ /de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtags rnam par dag pa yin zhing / sprul sku yang de nyid de longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de'i rnam sprul tsam yin pas so/ /'di yang mtha' gcig tu nges pa ma yin te/ gsal ba sprul sku stong pa chos kyi sku/ /zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ /zhes rgyu dus kyi sems gsal stong zung 'jug de'i gsal cha rnam par dag pa sprul sku/ stong cha rnam par dag pa chos sku/ zung 'jug rnam par dag pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bshad pa sogs bshad tshul mi 'dra ba'i rnam gzhag bshad pa mang du 'byung ba ni gsung rab 'chad pa kun gyi spyi lugs yin pas so/ ༈ /zhes dri ba mtha' ma zhus pa'i lan de nyid gsal bar ston pa la/ chos sku rgyal ba'i rang bzhin te/ /longs sku tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /sprul sku de yi rnam sprul yin/ /mi 'dra'i rnam gzhag bshad pa mang / /zhes pa 'di byung / de ltar legs par bshad pa de yan gyis ni rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa gzhung gi don dngos la dri ba zhu ba'i tshul gyi gnad khyad par can dang ldan pa sum cu tham pa zhus pa la de dag dang 'brel chags shing grangs rjes su mthun pa'i dris lan shin tu ngo mtshar la che cher rmad du byung ba sum cu tham pa yang bkas legs par gnang ba'i tshul rnams don bsdus sa bcad gzhung dang sbags pa'i tshul gyis legs par bshad zin pa yin zhes mtshams sbyar gyis ston pa la/

de yan gyis gnyis pa gzhung gi don la dri ba khyad par can sum cu zhus pa la/ de dang mthun pa'i dris lan ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sum cu gnang ba'i tshul rnams legs par bshad zin nas/ zhes pa 'di byung / de'i rjes su rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa mjug gi don la gsum ste/ chos kyi zab gnad gsum tshan lnga ru bsdus te bstan pa dang / dris lan mdzad pa'i dge ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba dang / dris lan mdzad pa po gang zag gnas bcas 'phros don zhal gdams dang bcas te bstan pa rnams su yod pa las/ dang po chos kyi zab gnad gsum tshan lnga ru bsdus te bstan pa de nyid ston par byed pa la/ tshul khrims byang sems dam tshig gsum/ /gzhi yin phyir na brtan par bya/ /dad dang snying rje 'dun pa gsum/ /sngon 'gro yin phyir sngon la bsgom/ /lha dang bla ma rang rig gsum/ /dngos gzhi yin phyir mnyam par gzhag /bsngo ba smon lam rjes dran gsum/ /mjug bsdud yin phyir mjug tu bya/ /sgyu ma stong nyid zung 'jug gsum/ /khyab byed yin phyir kun rgyas gdab/ /gsum tshan lnga ru spel ba yi/ /chos tshul bcu dang lnga phrag gcig /rjes su slob pa'i gang zag la/ /nor gyi snying po byin pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di byung / gnyis pa dris lan mdzad pa'i dge ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba de nyid ston par byed pa la/ de ltar khyod kyis nga la dris pa'i lan/ /dri med lung gi tshul bzhin bshad pa yi/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa 'di byung / gsum pa dris lan mdzad pa po'i gang zag gnas bcas 'phros don zhal gdams dang bcas te ston pa la/ 'dan gyi yul du skyes pa'i blo gsal ba'i dge sbyong dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya bas dris pa las/ 'phags pas lan du btab pa'i rab tu byed pa shing pho byi ba'i lo ston zla ra ba'i tshe nyi shu la mtshal mdor sbyar ba'o/ /'dir gsang sngags kyi tshul gtso cher 'byung bas dbang bskur ma thob pa rnams la bstan par mi bya'o/

/zhes pa 'di byung / de rnams kyis sa gsum gyi bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che la 'dan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyis dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i don 'grel khog phub mthong ba rab dga'i gsal byed bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba ma tshang ba med pa bstan zin to/ /da ni dris lan rnam par nges pa'i don 'grel khog phub mthong ba rab dga' zhes bya ba'i rtsom pa po'i gang zag sbyar byang smon lam dang bcas ston pa la/ 'dir smras pa/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs chos srid dpal 'byor gyis/ /rdzogs ldan bde la bkod pa'i bka' drin can/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i gsung rab kyi/ /don 'grel 'di ni sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya ba'i/ /rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho la/ /shes nas dad pa thob pa gang des sbyar/ /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don kun/ /sngar bzhin 'bad stsol med par lhun grub ste/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /phyi ma thogs med bde ba can bgrod shog /ces pa 'di yang shing mo glang gi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i yar ngo'i tshes la dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du sbyar ba 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig ces pa 'di byung / de ltar chos rgyal 'phags pas 'dan ma dbang phyug 'bum la gnang ba'i dris lan rnam par nges pa'i don 'grel khog phub mthong ba rab dga'i gsal byed bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ thub bstan lha chen gyi mkhan rab bcu pa mkhas pa'i dbang po mkhan chen chos kyi rje byams pa rin chen rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba yang srid du mar sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rjes su zhugs pa la brten/ sku'i skye ba 'dir yang sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi mas gsar du spel ba'i chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen gyi bstan pa'i gsal byed dam par gyur pa de nyid kyis dris lan rnam par nges pa'i don 'grel khog phub kyi 'bru bshad shin tu zhib pa'i legs bshad cig mdzad 'dug pas phal cher rdzogs par grub 'dug kyang /

rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa man chad 'phro can du lus 'dug pas/ sngon med kyi legs bshad de nyid kyi kha bskong du bsam nas/ don 'grel khog phub kyi rtsa ba'i rtsom pa po dpal skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid kyis yi ge'i tshegs skyung ba'i phyir 'bru 'grel rgyas bshad kyi spros pa bzhag nas/ sngar rang gis byas pa'i khog phub mthong ba rab dga'i nang bzhin la bsnan kha cung zad dang bcas sbrul lo zla ba drug pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas shing go re len gyi zhabs tog la rtag 'grus su bgyid pa'i shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa byams pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis gus spro'i sgo nas bgyis so/ /legs byas 'di'i mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe mthar phyin/ /phyi ma lhan cig dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms nas/ /sprul pas spyi sgos bstan pa rgyas byed shog /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 70 a myes zhabs/ 'phags pa rin po che la ldan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyis dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan gyi don 'grel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 69
